items.title: 韓国、国内港でロシア向け燃料積み込まれたとのウクライナ報道を否定
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ７日 ロイター] - 韓国大統領府は７日、ロシアが韓国の港から石油製品を輸入したとするウクライナの報道を否定し、その非難は不適切だと述べた。

ウクライナの制裁担当最高責任者は６日、ロシアの石油精製所へのドローン攻撃で引き起こされた燃料危機の影響がこうした韓国からの輸入で緩和されたと述べた。

英紙ガーディアンは先に、港湾記録や船舶追跡データをもとに、英国や欧州連合（ＥＵ）の制裁対象となっている船舶を含む７隻のタンカーに、韓国の港で燃料が積み込まれていたと報じた。

韓国大統領府は、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻以来、韓国が「国際社会と緊密に連携し、ロシアに対する制裁および輸出管理を一貫して実施してきた」と表明した。

さらに、韓国当局は事実関係を精査し、輸出管理上の問題がないか確認しており、問題が確認されれば必要な措置を講じるとした。

ウクライナと韓国の関係は、先月にゼレンスキー大統領が北朝鮮兵の捕虜２人の韓国への移送を公表したことをきっかけに緊張状態にある。韓国政府は、この移送は秘密裏に行われるはずだったと説明した。

ウクライナ外務省の報道官は７日、記者団に対し、この対立は「機密保持に関する合意の解釈の違い」に起因しているとし、問題解決に向けて非公開の外交ルートを通じて精力的な取り組みが進められていると述べた。

items.title: Oil price volatility tops list of earnings risks for Japan firms: Reuters poll
items.author: Kiyoshi Takenaka
items.creator: Kiyoshi Takenaka
items.summary: Volatility in the global crude oil market tops the list of major risks for Japanese companies, followed by foreign exchange fluctuations and rising interest rates, a Reuters survey showed on Thursday.
items.body:
Volatility in the global crude oil market tops the list of major risks for Japanese companies, followed by foreign exchange fluctuations and rising interest rates, a Reuters survey showed on Thursday.
The US-Israeli war on Iran, which began on February 28, has constrained crude oil supply, sent energy costs higher and driven up prices of a wide range of oil-derived products, including auto parts and construction materials.
In 2025, resource-poor Japan imported 94% of its crude oil from the Middle East.
About 37% of the survey's respondents chose crude market volatility as the top risk to their earnings prospects, while 21% picked foreign exchange moves and 19% selected higher interest rates.
"Rising energy costs driven by the crude oil market and investment cutbacks during a period of rising interest rates that are cooling domestic demand for cement - those are the risk factors," a manager at a company in the ceramics sector wrote in the survey.
The ceramics sector includes manufacturers of glass, cement and ceramic products.
Last month, the Bank of Japan raised interest rates to a 31-year high, with Governor Kazuo Ueda signalling that the central bank has entered a new phase focused on preventing inflation from overshooting its target, which opened the door to further rate hikes.
"Real estate demand is bound to slow down because of higher rates," a manager at a real estate firm said.
Multiple companies participating in the survey also cited uncertainties about the sustainability of artificial intelligence-related investment - which has spurred demand for advanced microchips and prompted a rapid buildup of data centres - as a potential earnings risk.
"It is vitally important for corporate management to ascertain how much longer an increase in demand brought about by AI investment lasts and when such demand starts turning lower," a respondent at a machinery maker said.
Last month, the Mitsubishi Research Institute said AI investment, centred on data centres, is projected to expand over the medium to long term, but the pace of investment may be adjusted due to factors like power constraints, stricter regulations and rising costs.
The poll was conducted by Nikkei Research for Reuters from September 18 to October 2. Nikkei Research contacted 508 companies, of which 215 responded on the condition of anonymity.
On financial performance, 32% of respondents see net earnings for the first half of the current business year beating their own forecasts, while 22% believe they are missing their original outlook. And 46% expect half-year results to be in line with initial projections.
A fiscal year starts in April for most major Japanese companies. Earnings announcements for the April-to-September period are scheduled for later this month and into November.
For the second half of the fiscal year, more companies are bearish than bullish about their financial outlooks.
About 22% of respondents expect net earnings to fall short of their initial forecasts, 20% expect October-to-March earnings to exceed their estimates and 58% say their initial outlook remains intact, the survey showed.

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Britain and Germany will launch a joint partnership to counter sabotage and cyberattacks as Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Chancellor Friedrich Merz meet in Berlin on Thursday, shortly after both leaders warned of the hybrid threat from Russia.
items.body:
Britain and Germany will launch a joint partnership to counter sabotage and cyberattacks as Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Chancellor Friedrich Merz meet in Berlin on Thursday, shortly after both leaders warned of the hybrid threat from Russia.
New joint partnership will involve sharing information, and coordinating action to monitor, deter and disrupt threats to critical infrastructure or via cyber attacks and sabotage, Downing Street said
UK says adversaries, "especially Russia", pose a hybrid threat in Europe and beyond; British ministers were last month due to [USN:L8N45H0EB TEXT:"brief defence companies"] and critical national infrastructure providers on the threat posed by Russia
Germany's head of foreign intelligence on Monday [USN:L8N45R0HH TEXT:"warned that"] "the confrontation we are facing with Russia has taken on a new, more dangerous dimension"
Last month, Germany said it had concluded [USN:L8N44T1P2 TEXT:"Russia was responsible"] for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport in August

items.title: サムスン電子、第3四半期営業益は約9倍に　ＡＩ需要が追い風
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ８日 ロイター] - メモリー半導体世界最大手の韓国サムスン電子は８日、第３・四半期の営業利益が前年同期の約９倍となる見通しを示した。人工知能（ＡＩ）向け半導体の需要急増がメモリー事業の収益を押し上げ、アナリスト予想を上回った。

規制当局への提出資料によると、営業利益は１０７兆４０００億ウォン（８０１億７０００万ドル）の見込み。ＬＳＥＧスマートエスティメートの予想は１０６兆１０００億ウォンだった。

営業利益は４四半期連続で過去最高を更新する見通し。ＡＩインフラ需要の急増がメモリー半導体の供給拡大ペースを上回っており、こうした需給ギャップは２０２７年まで続くとみられている。

従来型のＤＲＡＭやＮＡＮＤ型フラッシュメモリーの供給逼迫に加え、ＡＩ用途で大量のデータを処理するのに不可欠な高帯域メモリー（ＨＢＭ）の需要拡大を背景に、価格が急騰している。

第３・四半期の売上高は前年同期比１２７％増の１９５兆ウォンとなる見通し。

事業部門別の内訳を含む詳細な決算は１０月２９日に発表する予定。

利益改善の大部分はメモリー半導体が占めるとみられる。アナリストは、供給が需要に追い付かない状況が続くと予想。世界のメモリー生産能力のうちＡＩ関連需要に振り向けられる割合が高まるにつれ、２７年には需給の不均衡がさらに拡大する可能性がある。

アナリストによると、従来型ＤＲＡＭのビット換算の出荷量は在庫が限られるため、おおむね横ばいにとどまる見通し。一方、ＨＢＭの出荷量はＨＢＭ４の旺盛な需要を背景に前四半期から大幅に増える可能性がある。

ダグラス・リサーチ・アドバイザリーのダグラス・キム氏は、サムスンの第３・四半期のＨＢＭ出荷量がビット換算で前四半期比５０％近く増加したと推計した。

ただ、ウォン高によりドル建て海外売上高のウォン換算額が目減りし、こうした増益効果の一部が相殺された可能性はある。

メモリー半導体の活況は、サムスンの他の事業、特にスマートフォンや家電部門にとって課題にもなっている。これらの部門では部品コスト上昇による圧力が強まっている。

メモリー価格の上昇は半導体部門に恩恵をもたらす一方、自社のスマートフォンなど電子機器のコストを押し上げ、これらの事業の利益率を圧迫している。

items.title: Inflación en Colombia no encuentra techo: subió a 6,29% en septiembre
items.author: Daniel Guerrero
items.summary: De acuerdo con el DANE, la variación mensual fue de 0,37%. Los alimentos, siguen siendo uno de los principales impulsores de los precios en el país.
items.body: Bogotá — El Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE), acaba de informar que la inflación en Colombia subió nuevamente durante septiembre y ahora es de 6,29% anual. La autoridad estadística destacó que la variación mensual fue de 0,37%, por encima de lo proyectado por el mercado financiero colombiano. Según la entidad, los precios de los alimentos, así como de la vivienda, entre los que se destacan los arriendos y los servicios públicos, siguen siendo los principales motores del aumento de precios. En el mes de septiembre de 2026, el IPC registró una variación de 0,37% en comparación con agosto de 2026, dos divisiones se ubicaron por encima del promedio nacional: Educación (1,43%) y, por último, Alimentos y bebidas no alcohólicas (0,78%). Por debajo se ubicaron: Alojamiento, agua, electricidad, gas y otros combustibles (0,31%), Restaurantes y hoteles (0,28%), Bebidas alcohólicas y tabaco (0,23%), Muebles, artículos para el hogar y para la conservación ordinaria del hogar (0,23%), Transporte (0,13%), Salud (0,12%), Prendas de vestir y calzado (0,10%), Bienes y servicios diversos (0,05%), Información y comunicación (-0,02%) y, por último, Recreación y cultura (-0,21%). Los mayores aportes a la variación mensual del IPC (0,37%), se ubicaron en las divisiones de: Alimentos y bebidas no alcohólicas, Alojamiento, agua, electricidad, gas y otros combustibles y Educación, las cuales aportaron 0,30 puntos porcentuales a la variación total. Según el DANE, en septiembre de 2026 en comparación con agosto de 2026, la variación de las subclases que más aportaron al índice total fueron: arriendo imputado (0,47%), hortalizas y legumbres frescas (9,10%), arriendo efectivo (0,46%), papas (7,29%), educación preescolar y básica primaria (2,09%), tomate (10,47%), educación secundaria (2,43%), transporte de pasajeros y equipaje en avión (12,25%), carne de res y derivados (0,74%) y huevos (2,29%). Las subclases con mayores aportes negativos a la variación fueron: vehículo particular nuevo o usado (-1,05%), legumbres secas (-2,49%), gas (-0,51%), café y productos a base de café (-1,21%) y artículos en oro, plata y piedras preciosas y su reparación (-2,91%). En septiembre de 2026, la variación mensual del IPC por nivel de ingresos fue: Pobres (0,41%), Vulnerables (0,39%), Clase media (0,38%), Ingresos altos (0,32%) y, por último, Total nivel de ingresos (0,37%).

items.title: Barn owls, bees, puffins and hedgehogs to feature on UK banknotes
items.author: David Milliken
items.creator: David Milliken
items.summary: Barn owls, bumblebees, puffins and hedgehogs will feature on new Bank of England banknotes over the coming years, replacing World War Two leader Winston Churchill and other historic figures, the Bank of England said on Thursday.
items.body:
Barn owls, bumblebees, puffins and hedgehogs will feature on new Bank of England banknotes over the coming years, replacing World War Two leader Winston Churchill and other historic figures, the Bank of England said on Thursday.
The BoE's decision in March to [USN:L8N3ZY174 TEXT:"no longer feature famous Britons"] on future banknotes, in favour of native wildlife, dismayed politicians across the political spectrum and prompted speculation that the central bank wanted to avoid controversies around historic figures.
The BoE said the change would make its banknotes more distinctive and harder to counterfeit, and followed a public consultation where people had been invited to choose between different categories of images.
Almost 500,000 people voted on a [USN:L8N4291CL TEXT:"selection of 18 animals"] released by the central bank in June.
The buff-tailed bumblebee was the most popular creature on the shortlist, followed by the barn owl and the European hedgehog. Red foxes and common kingfishers received more votes than the Atlantic puffin, which the BoE selected to ensure a marine animal was on the list.
"I am delighted that nearly half a million people responded to our wildlife imagery consultation, showing that cash still matters," BoE Chief Cashier Victoria Cleland said.
Cash usage has fallen steeply in Britain in recent years, accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic which led to almost all retailers accepting contactless card and smartphone payments.
Under 10% of payments were made by cash in 2024, but trade body UK Finance said it expected the decline to level off as a small percentage of Britons strongly preferred to use cash.
The new banknotes will continue to feature the monarch. The £5 Churchill note, issued in 2016, is the first due to be replaced, followed by the £10 with novelist Jane Austen, £20 with artist JMW Turner and £50 with mathematician Alan Turing.

items.title: Blues, Sharks meet after enduring rough performances
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The St. Louis Blues hope a return home can spark the offense when the San Jose Sharks visit on Thursday.
items.body:
The St. Louis Blues hope a return home can spark the offense when the San Jose Sharks visit on Thursday.
The Blues' season began with a three-game road trip, and the initial success of a 4-0 shutout over the Dallas Stars. St. Louis then lost its next two games while being outscored 10-3, including Tuesday's 4-2 loss to the Chicago Blackhawks.
Despite a 13-4 shots edge in the third period and a 27-21 shots advantage in the game as a whole, the Blues couldn't mount a comeback against Chicago. St. Louis is averaging 19 even-strength shots per game, and four of the team's seven goals have come in 5-on-5 play.
Connor McMichael leads St. Louis with three points (one goal, two assists). Robert Thomas and Dylan Holloway led the Blues in goals last season, but the forwards are each still looking for their first point of the new campaign.
Tuesday was "a game we feel like we can step up and take over, so yeah, it is frustrating. You feel like you're letting the group down," Thomas told The Athletic.
"But that's the beauty of the league. We're playing again tomorrow night and we have another opportunity to do it in our home opener."
San Jose is also looking to bounce back after one of its worst-ever offensive games. The Sharks were outshot 26-13 in Monday's 5-0 loss to Dallas, tying the eighth-lowest shot total in franchise history.
Since the Sharks scored nine times while winning their first two games of the season, Macklin Celebrini's absence stands out as the obvious reason for Monday's struggles. Celebrini took part in the warm-up skate on Monday but was a late scratch from the lineup due to a lower-body injury.
Celebrini didn't practice on Tuesday or Wednesday, and Sharks coach Ryan Warsofsky told San Jose Hockey Now on Tuesday that the forward is day-to-day. Warsofsky described the unspecified injury as "something we've been trying to manage here a little bit."
It remains uncertain if Celebrini will face the Blues, but "our identity doesn't change whether Mack's in the lineup or not. He's a great player, we know that, but we need guys to step up and fill some spots," Warsofsky said.
Celebrini has five assists in two games, leading the Sharks in both helpers and points. Will Smith and Igor Chernyshov share the team's goal lead with two apiece.
Yaroslav Askarov has been in net for all three of San Jose's games, posting an .862 save percentage and 3.86 goals-against average. After allowing five goals on 26 Dallas shots, Askarov may get a rest Thursday so backup goalie Alex Nedeljkovic could get his first action of the season.
Joel Hofer has started two of the Blues' three games, with Jordan Binnington starting last Saturday's 6-1 loss to the Colorado Avalanche. Binnington would be lined up to face the Sharks if St. Louis is using a strict goalie rotation, though Hofer finished last season as the team's preferred choice in net.
Veteran defenseman Colton Parayko is expected to play Thursday in his 804th game with the Blues, the second-most in franchise history. He's currently tied with Barret Jackman.
The Sharks have a nine-game points streak (5-0-4) against the Blues over the previous three seasons.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Blackhawks playing inspired hockey, next take on Islanders
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Chicago Blackhawks got a glimpse Tuesday night of what they envisioned when they brought back three-time Stanley Cup champion Patrick Kane to mentor their young roster.
items.body:
The Chicago Blackhawks got a glimpse Tuesday night of what they envisioned when they brought back three-time Stanley Cup champion Patrick Kane to mentor their young roster.
For the New York Islanders and defenseman Alexander Romanov, Tuesday night represented the worst-case scenario for a second straight season.
The Blackhawks look to win their second straight game, while the Islanders begin adjusting to life without Romanov, when Chicago visits the New York Islanders on Thursday night in Elmont, N.Y.
Both teams were off Wednesday after playing Tuesday, when the Blackhawks earned their first win by beating the visiting St. Louis Blues 4-2 and the Islanders fell to the host New York Rangers 5-2.
Sam Rinzel and Anton Frondell gave the Blackhawks the lead for good by scoring within a two-minute span early in the second for Chicago, which was outscored 15-5 by the Vegas Golden Knights, Utah Mammoth and Buffalo Sabres during a season-opening road trip.
"A lot of times, to get that first win when you haven't won in a few, you've got to kind of grind it out," Blackhawks head coach Jeff Blashill said. "You probably feel a little bit of that weight (lifted). Now we've got to build on it."
Chicago's roster features six first-round draft picks selected since 2022, including Rinzel (2022, 25th overall) and Frondell (2025, third).
Frank Nazar, who was also a first-round pick in 2022 (13th), provided insurance against St. Louis by scoring an empty-netter in the final five seconds. Artyom Levshunov, a 2024 first-round selection (second overall), had the primary assist on Frondell's go-ahead goal.
In addition, center Connor Bedard, picked first overall in the 2023 draft, is recovering from left shoulder surgery in July.
Chicago has missed the playoffs in eight of the last nine seasons and hasn't advanced past the first round since 2015, when Kane helped the Blackhawks win the Stanley Cup for the third time in six seasons.
The Blackhawks selected Kane first overall in the 2007 draft before trading him to the New York Rangers in 2023. Kane spent the previous three seasons with the Detroit Red Wings before signing a two-year deal with Chicago as a free agent in July.
The 37-year-old right winger received a lengthy standing ovation during a video tribute prior to faceoff Tuesday, when he had two shots in just under 21 minutes on ice.
The Blackhawks will be without Teuvo Teravainen, who sustained a lower-body injury Tuesday. Blashill said the forward would not accompany the team to New York.
The Islanders, who missed the playoffs for the second straight year last spring, showed a hint of their potential in their home opener Saturday, when New York routed the New Jersey Devils 6-0.
But the Islanders never led Tuesday, falling behind the Rangers 2-0 before Bo Horvat and Cal Ritchie scored within 1:56 early in the second. They had just eight shots the rest of the way, including five in the third, when Alexis Lafreniere iced the win for the Rangers by collecting two empty-net goals in the final 1:38.
"We had a chance to take the lead -- that maybe changes the game," Islanders head coach Peter DeBoer said. "It's not easy in this league playing from behind."
The third period will likely be the final regular-season action for Romanov, who exited with 12:04 left. The Islanders announced Wednesday that Romanov tore the ACL in his right knee and will require surgery that will sideline him for six to eight months.
It will be a second straight lost season for Romanov, who missed the final 62 games last year due to a left shoulder injury sustained against the Dallas Stars on Nov. 18.
--Field Level Media

items.title: 意識回復の米死刑囚は「怒りと混乱」、重い後遺症に苦しむ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jonathan Allen

[７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jonathan Allen

[７日 ロイター] - 米南部テネシー州で死刑執行の失敗後に意識を回復したクリスタ・パイク死刑囚（５０）が「怒りと混乱」の状態にあり、肺炎や腕の深刻な腫れなど重い症状に苦しんでいる。弁護団が７日明らかにした。

弁護団によると、パイク死刑囚は６日に意識を取り戻し、会話が可能になった。州当局が自分を処刑しようとしたことを認識している一方、自身に何が起きたのかを尋ねたり、被害者遺族について質問したりしているという。

現在も病院のベッドに拘束された状態で、飲食や嚥下（えんげ）ができず、肺炎を患っている。著しく腫れた両手と両腕は動かせず、失われた運動機能が回復するかどうかも不明とされる。弁護団は「長い回復への道のりになる」と説明した。

パイク死刑囚は１週間前、テネシー州の刑務所で薬物注射による死刑執行を受けたが、２回投与されたペントバルビタールで死亡せず、意識不明の重体となって病院に搬送された。同州では今年５月にも別の死刑囚の執行で静脈確保に失敗する事案が発生しており、リー州知事は年内の死刑執行を停止して調査を進めている。

また州裁判所は７日、執行に使用された注射器や薬剤関連資料、内部通信記録などの保存を州当局に命じた。弁護団は執行に使われた薬剤の成分分析などを要求。さらにパイク死刑囚を終身刑に減刑するよう求めている。

items.author: CNA
items.summary: SEOUL, Oct 8 : Samsung Electronics on Thursday projected a nearly nine-fold jump in third-quarter operating profit from a year earlier, beating analysts' estimates as booming demand for artificial intelligence chips drove strong memory earnings.The world's largest memory chipmaker estimated an operating profi

Samsung Q3 profit jumps nearly nine-fold as AI memory boom lifts chip earnings

The logo of Samsung Electronics is seen at the company's store in Seoul, South Korea, April 15, 2025. REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji

FAST

SEOUL, Oct 8 : Samsung Electronics on Thursday projected a nearly nine-fold jump in third-quarter operating profit from a year earlier, beating analysts' estimates as booming demand for artificial intelligence chips drove strong memory earnings.
The world's largest memory chipmaker estimated an operating profit of 107.4 trillion won ($80.17 billion) for the July-September period, compared with an LSEG SmartEstimate of 106.1 trillion won, a regulatory filing showed.
Samsung's fourth consecutive quarter of record operating profit, up from 12.17 trillion won a year earlier, underscores how soaring demand for AI infrastructure has outstripped memory chip supply growth, a gap expected to persist into 2027.
Prices have soared due to the tight supply of conventional DRAM and NAND chips as well as growing demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM), essential for processing vast amounts of data for AI applications.

Third-quarter revenue would likely rise 127 per cent to 195 trillion won from a year earlier, Samsung said.
The company will release detailed results, including a breakdown of earnings by business division, on October 29.
Memory chips are expected to account for the bulk of the earnings improvement. Analysts expect supply to continue to lag demand, with the imbalance potentially widening in 2027 as AI-related demand absorbs an increasing share of global memory capacity.
Against that backdrop, conventional DRAM bit shipments are expected to remain broadly flat because of limited inventories, while HBM shipments could rise sharply from the previous quarter on strong demand for HBM4, analysts said.
Douglas Kim of Douglas Research Advisory estimated that Samsung's HBM bit shipments expanded by close to 50 per cent quarter-over-quarter in the third quarter.
However, a stronger South Korean won may have offset some of those gains by reducing the value of dollar-denominated overseas sales when converted into local currency.
The memory chip boom also presents a challenge for Samsung's other businesses, particularly its smartphone and consumer electronics divisions, which face mounting pressure from higher component costs.
Higher memory prices, while benefiting Samsung's semiconductor arm, are raising costs for its own smartphones and other electronic devices, squeezing margins in those businesses.
($1 = 1,339.5700 won)

Source: Reuters

items.title: 仏政府、高校生デモ警備で「閃光手りゅう弾」使用一時停止　過剰対応と非難高まる
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Makini Brice　Janis Laizans

[パリ ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Makini Brice　Janis Laizans

[パリ ７日 ロイター] - フランス政府は７日、高校生らによる抗議活動への警備で使用していたスタングレネード（閃光手りゅう弾）の使用を一時停止すると発表した。北部ランスで今週、１５歳の若者が機動隊との衝突で片手を失う重傷を負ったことを受け、警察の過剰な実力行使だとの非難が高まったことが背景にある。

ヌニェス内相は、ランスで発生した若者の負傷事故について、スタングレネードが原因である可能性が高いとして使用停止を指示した。「事実関係が明らかになるまで、高校生の抗議活動では使用を停止する」と述べた。また内相によると、警察監察機関にはこれまでに計１８件の事案が調査のため付託されている。

抗議活動は収束の気配を見せておらず、前日に続いて全国で５００校超が閉鎖された。高校生や教員、労働者を代表する組合は８日に追加デモを計画している。一連の抗議活動は２週間以上続いており、６カ月後に予定される大統領選を前に、マクロン大統領に対する国民の不満の広がりが浮き彫りになった。

ジェフライ教育相は議会で、放火や破壊行為によって２４校の高校が深刻な被害を受け、数週間にわたり閉鎖を余儀なくされると説明した。約３万人の生徒が対面授業を受けられない状況になるという。同相は復旧費用について２０００万－３０００万ユーロ（２２００万－３４００万ドル）に上るとの見通しを示した。

ルコルニュ首相は７日夜の国民向け演説で、生徒側の要求を精査した上で、教員確保や校舎改修などに関する提案を１０月末に公表すると表明したものの、具体策には言及しなかった。首相は「過去には実現不可能な約束が数多くなされてきた。必要なのは具体的で迅速かつ財源が確保された対応だ」と述べた。ただ即時対応が示されなかったことから、抗議活動の沈静化につながる公算は乏しそうだ。

パリ中心部のリセ・ラマルティーヌ高校では、生徒らが校門を封鎖し、国歌を歌いながら抗議を続けた。生徒らは老朽化校舎や教員不足、授業の欠員など教育環境の悪化を問題視し、公教育全体の改善を求めている。

同じパリ中心部のシアンス・ポ大学前では、ごみ箱で築かれたバリケード周辺で警察が催涙ガスを使用し、参加者を排除。人権団体や労働組合、学生、一部野党勢力は、警察が抗議活動の鎮圧に過度な力を行使していると批判している。

抗議参加者からは、教育環境の悪化がフランスの若者の学力低下につながっているとの意見が出ている。経済協力開発機構（ＯＥＣＤ）の学習到達度調査（ＰＩＳＡ）によると、フランスの１５歳の読解力スコアは２０２５年に２０１５年比で４３ポイント低下し、ＯＥＣＤ加盟国の中で最大の下落幅で、数学の成績も同様に大きく低下した。

もっとも政府は低成長下で財政赤字の抑制を迫られており、教員不足や老朽化した校舎、地域間格差の是正に充てる余力資金は限られている。

世論調査で首位に立つ極右政党、国民連合（ＲＮ）の大統領候補マリーヌ・ルペン氏は、学校に損害を与えた者が修理費を負担すべきだと主張した。政府も同様の立場で、加害者負担制度の創設を目指す法案を議会で審議している。

ＢＦＭテレビ向けのエラブ調査によると、フランス国民の７２％が学生側の要求を正当と考える一方、５５％は抗議活動を終結させるべきだと回答した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Lawder

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Lawder

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - 米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）は７日、２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の加盟国十数カ国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）、ポーランドの貿易相が、構造的な過剰生産能力と、過剰生産を助長する「非市場的」政策の解消に向けた行動を求める米国主導の声明に署名したと発表した。

市場経済を重視する国・地域の高官らは、経済協力開発機構（ＯＥＣＤ）貿易委員会の会合に合わせ、共同声明に合意した。米国の主導で先週、ミルウォーキーで開かれたＧ２０貿易相会合では、産業の過剰生産能力問題について合意に至らなかった。

貿易相らは７日の声明で「全ての国に対し、市場をゆがめ、問題を助長する非市場的な政策や慣行の使用をやめることなどで、自国経済の構造的な過剰生産能力と過剰生産の解消に向けた措置を講じるよう求める」と表明した。

「こうした措置が取られない中、このような政策や慣行によるゆがみから自国の産業、労働者、経済を守るために行動する国が増えていることに留意する」とした。

声明には、アルゼンチン、オーストラリア、カナダ、ＥＵ、フランス、ドイツ、インド、イタリア、日本、韓国、メキシコ、ポーランド、トルコ、英国、米国の貿易相が署名した。

一方、Ｇ２０加盟国の中国、ブラジル、インドネシア、ロシア、サウジアラビア、南アフリカは署名に加わらなかった。

items.title: Samsung Q3 profit jumps nearly nine-fold as AI memory boom lifts chip earnings
items.author: Heekyong Yang, Joyce Lee
items.creator: Heekyong Yang, Joyce Lee
items.summary: Samsung Electronics on Thursday projected a nearly nine-fold jump in third-quarter operating profit from a year earlier, beating analysts' estimates as booming demand for artificial intelligence chips drove strong memory earnings.
items.body:
Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) on Thursday projected a nearly nine-fold jump in third-quarter operating profit from a year earlier, beating analysts' estimates as booming demand for artificial intelligence chips drove strong memory earnings.
The world's largest memory chipmaker estimated an operating profit of 107.4 trillion won ($80.17 billion) for the July-September period, compared with an LSEG SmartEstimate of 106.1 trillion won, a regulatory filing showed.
Samsung's fourth consecutive quarter of [USN:L4N45O0LB TEXT:"record operating profit"], up from 12.17 trillion won a year earlier, underscores how soaring demand for AI infrastructure has outstripped memory chip supply growth, a gap expected to persist into 2027.
Prices have soared due to the tight supply of conventional DRAM and NAND chips as well as growing demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM), essential for processing vast amounts of data for AI applications.
Third-quarter revenue would likely rise 127% to 195 trillion won from a year earlier, Samsung said.
The company will release detailed results, including a breakdown of earnings by business division, on October 29.
Memory chips are expected to account for the bulk of the earnings improvement. Analysts expect supply to continue to lag demand, with the imbalance potentially widening in 2027 as AI-related demand absorbs an increasing share of global memory capacity.
Against that backdrop, conventional DRAM bit shipments are expected to remain broadly flat because of limited inventories, while HBM shipments could rise sharply from the previous quarter on strong demand for HBM4, analysts said.
Douglas Kim of Douglas Research Advisory estimated that Samsung's HBM bit shipments expanded by close to 50% quarter-over-quarter in the third quarter.
However, a stronger South Korean won may have offset some of those gains by reducing the value of dollar-denominated overseas sales when converted into local currency.
The memory chip boom also presents a challenge for Samsung's other businesses, particularly its smartphone and consumer electronics divisions, which face mounting pressure from higher component costs.
Higher memory prices, while benefiting Samsung's semiconductor arm, are raising costs for its own smartphones and other electronic devices, squeezing margins in those businesses.
($1 = 1,339.5700 won)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Diana Novak Jones

[７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Diana Novak Jones

[７日 ロイター] - 米南部フロリダ州のウスマイヤー司法長官は７日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「インスタグラム」と「フェイスブック」（ＦＢ）に対し、１０代の利用者向けに保護措置を講じることを求めて同州パスコ郡の裁判所に仮処分申請した。州内の１４歳未満の住民がアクセスした場合には利用できなくすることや、１０代の利用者に対して全体の１日当たりの利用時間を２時間に制限すること、自動再生や無限のスクロールなどの機能を無効にすることを義務付けるように求めている。

訴状によると、これらの変更を直ちに実施し、係争中も適用するよう訴えている。

メタは８月、１０代の利用などを巡る訴訟で米４８州および首都ワシントンと和解し、最大で１８０億ドルを支払うとともに、１０代の利用者向けに改善策を講じることで合意した。フロリダ州は和解に加わっておらず、メタの広報担当者は「フロリダ州司法長官は税金を活用して保護者に権限を与え、１０代の若者を保護するようユーチューブやＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）に働きかけるべきだ。訴訟が始まって数年間が経過した今、司法長官が根拠のない仮処分申請を選んだことを遺憾に思う」とコメントした。

フロリダ州は裁判所への提出書類で、和解について「単なるお仕置きに過ぎず、皮肉にもビジネス上のコストと見なされるだろう。いずれにせよ、今後この種の行為を防ぐことはできなくなる」と批判した。

items.title: ペスト研究所員死亡、米へのリスク低いとＣＤＣ　渡航者監視の用意
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[７日 ロイター] - 米疾病対策センター（ＣＤＣ）のシュワルツ所長は７日、ロシア・シベリアにあるペスト研究所の職員が死亡した事例について、米国へのリスクは極めて低いとの認識を示した。ただ、渡航者の監視や検査を実施する用意はできているとした。

ワシントンで開かれたイベントで「国土安全保障省、国務省、戦争省（国防総省）などの政府機関と連携し、当該地域から米国に入国する人がいれば正確に把握できる体制を整えている」と述べた。

ニューヨークのジョン・Ｆ・ケネディ（ＪＦＫ）国際空港にはＣＤＣの検疫所があり、当該地域から米国に入国する渡航者の監視・検査を実施できると説明した。

厚生省はＪＦＫ空港で検査を実施する計画があるかどうかについて、現時点でコメント要請に応じていない。

同省報道官によると、シベリアから米国へ渡航する人は年間約２００人。ロシアと米国の直行便は、ロシアによる２０２２年のウクライナ侵攻開始以降、停止されている。

ロシアの衛生当局は７日、シベリアで流行が広がるリスクはないと表明した。

シュワルツ氏は「政府全体で取り組んでいるのは、この脅威が一体どのようなものなのかを正確に把握することだ」とした上で、「米国への脅威は極めて低いと強く確信している」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領は７日、今回の事例について、生物兵器が原因ではないとの見方を示した。

items.title: トランプ氏、フロリダのゴルフクラブを大統領別荘に改築も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Christian Martinez　Bo Erickson

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Christian Martinez　Bo Erickson

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は７日、フロリダ州ウェストパームビーチにある自身のゴルフクラブ「トランプ・インターナショナル・ゴルフクラブ」の一区画をキャンプ・デービッドのような大統領別荘に改築する計画を支持した。

この計画について記者団から問われた際、「素晴らしいアイデアだ。頻繁に利用されることになるだろう」と述べた。

さらに、「軍やシークレットサービスから提案されたことだが、その利点は周囲に高層ビルがないことだ」とし、「ドナルド・J・トランプ大統領国際空港」と最近改名された空港への近さや周辺に住宅が少ない点も挙げた。

トランプ氏は「これは私のためではなく、将来の全ての大統領のためになるものだ」とも語った。

このゴルフクラブは、２０２４年にトランプ氏に対する暗殺未遂事件が起きた現場でもある。容疑者の男は半自動小銃を持ってコース近くの茂みに潜んでいたところ、シークレットサービスのエージェントたちに拘束された。男は今年２月に終身刑を言い渡された。

地元紙パームビーチ・ポストが最初に報じたところによると、同クラブを代表する弁護士が先月、パームビーチ郡当局宛ての書簡でこの構想を提案した。同紙によると、この計画はクラブの一区画を大統領や世界の指導者のための恒久的な拠点として指定する内容という。ロイターはこの書簡の内容を直ちに確認することはできなかった。

同クラブを代表する弁護士は米紙ワシントン・ポストに対し、大統領公邸および関連施設の建設費用はトランプ氏が負担すると語った。

シークレットサービスと国防総省はコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

items.title: STF exclui créditos presumidos de ICMS da base de cálculo do PIS e da Cofins
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) decidiu nesta quarta-feira que créditos fiscais presumidos de ICMS não podem ser incluídos na base de cálculo do Programa de Integração Social (PIS) e da Contribuição para Financiamento da Seguridade Social (Cofins), segundo comunicado da corte.
items.body:
O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) decidiu nesta quarta-feira que créditos fiscais presumidos de ICMS não podem ser incluídos na base de cálculo do Programa de Integração Social (PIS) e da Contribuição para Financiamento da Seguridade Social (Cofins), segundo comunicado da corte.
A decisão, aguardada há muito por empresas do país e que pode implicar em impacto bilionário nas contas do governo federal, foi tomada no julgamento do Recurso Extraordinário (RE) 835818, com repercussão geral reconhecida.
O crédito é um benefício fiscal dado por Estados para incentivar cadeias econômicas e o setor privado defendia que ele não poderia ser incluído na base para se calcular o ICMS devido uma vez que ele é resultado de desconto de tributação decidida por governos estaduais.
Segundo a maioria do Plenário do STF, os créditos "não representam riqueza própria da empresa e, portanto, não podem ser considerados faturamento, nem receita para fins de incidência do PIS e da Cofins".
O STF afirmou no comunicado que na sessão desta quarta-feira o ministro Dias Toffoli alterou seu entendimento para acompanhar essa posição, citando que tal avaliação poderia gerar insegurança jurídica. Atualmente há milhares de processos no Brasil sobre o assunto.
Ao elaborar o projeto de orçamento deste ano, o governo federal estimou em R$16,5 bilhões o impacto de uma derrota no caso.
A Procuradoria-Geral da Fazenda Nacional (PGFN) afirmou que vai esperar a publicação do acórdão do julgamento para avaliar eventuais recursos contra a decisão, mas citou que o resultado vai contra decisões anteriores do próprio STF.
"O resultado do julgamento foi formado com a participação de quatro votos proferidos por ministros que já não integram o tribunal, dentre eles o voto original do relator (Marco Aurélio)", afirmou a PGFN se referindo também aos ministros aposentados Rosa Weber, Ricardo Lewandowski e Luís Roberto Barroso.
"Esse cenário fez com que a composição atual do STF não participasse integralmente do debate e da construção do entendimento final", acrescentou a procuradoria citando "preocupação institucional".

items.title: ＥＵ加盟国、ロシア制裁で対象追加に合意　大半は軍需産業関連＝外交筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Julia Payne

[ブリュッセル ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Julia Payne

[ブリュッセル ７日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国の大使らは７日、ロシア制裁枠組みの下で新たに１６４６件の個人・団体を制裁対象に追加することで合意した。３人のＥＵ外交筋が明らかにした。対象の大半はロシアの軍需産業に関連している。

外交筋によると、新たな制裁対象の半数超は、ロシアの弾道ミサイル「９Ｍ７２３イスカンデルＭ」の生産網に関与する企業や個人。イスカンデルＭは米国製防空システム「パトリオット」でのみ迎撃可能とされる。

制裁対象には、ミサイルの試験や研究に関わる組織、イスカンデル向けの固体燃料やロケットエンジンの製造企業、各種ミサイルに使用される特殊繊維製品や合成繊維、炭素繊維のメーカーが含まれる。そのほかドローン（無人機）メーカーや潜水艦の整備を手掛ける造船所、ロシアが占領するウクライナ領で議会選挙に立候補したロシア人政治家７７人も制裁対象に加えられた。

この制裁措置は１２日に開かれるＥＵ外相理事会で正式採択される見通し。

またＥＵは、ロシアと北朝鮮の関係強化への懸念を踏まえ、ロシアの戦争遂行を支援しているとして北朝鮮の団体・個人７件も新たに制裁対象に加えた。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は７月、北朝鮮製ミサイルの在庫を補充したとみられるロシアが、約１年ぶりに北朝鮮製ミサイルでウクライナを攻撃したと明らかにしていた。

items.title: Saints QB Tyler Shough dealing with sore left hand, expects to play Sunday
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New Orleans quarterback Tyler Shough doesn't expect his sore left hand to prevent him from playing on Sunday against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.body:
New Orleans quarterback Tyler Shough doesn't expect his sore left hand to prevent him from playing on Sunday against the Minnesota Vikings.
Shough's non-throwing hand was wrapped during the team's walk-through on Wednesday, when he was listed as limited in an estimation of availability.
He hurt the hand when it was hit during the Saints' 45-24 home loss to the Atlanta Falcons on Monday night.
"Yeah, just something to keep working on," Shough, 27, said on a video from the team. "Just got it banged up in the game. Nothing different than anybody else is dealing with quite honestly. Just bumps and bruises and stuff like that."
He played the entire game, completing 30 of 48 passes (62.5%) for 286 yards and one touchdown. The Falcons recorded 12 quarterback hits and two sacks.
"It's a shorter week, so I'm obviously sore today, but it's not going to limit me really at all," Shough said of the 1-3 Saints' home game against the Vikings (4-0).
Shough has played all 306 offensive snaps for New Orleans this season and leads the league with 121 completions and 180 attempts. He has thrown for 1,203 yards, nine touchdowns and three interceptions. Shough also has rushed 16 times for 72 yards and one TD.
He made the NFL All-Rookie Team in 2025, completing 67.6% of his passes for 2,384 yards, 10 TDs and six picks in 11 games. He went 5-4 as a starter.
New Orleans running back Alvin Kamara (back), wide receiver Chris Olave (rest), linebacker Kaden Elliss (calf), edge rusher Anfernee Jennings (knee) and wide receiver/return specialist Barion Brown (thigh) were listed as did not practice on Wednesday's injury report.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump premiará a Musk, Huang y otros magnates tecnológicos con medallas de ciencia e innovación
items.author: Hadriana Lowenkron
items.summary: Trump reconocerá a Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Sergey Brin y Lisa Su con la Medalla Nacional de la Ciencia, mientras Michael Dell y Satya Nadella recibirán la Medalla Nacional de Tecnología e Innovación.
items.body: Bloomberg — El presidente Donald Trump tiene previsto entregar al multimillonario Elon Musk y a otros magnates del sector tecnológico unas medallas en reconocimiento a la ciencia y la innovación tecnológica durante una cumbre que se celebrará este jueves, lo que pone de relieve los estrechos vínculos entre su administración y Silicon Valley. Musk, Jensen Huang, de Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ); Sergey Brin, de Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ) (empresa matriz de Google); y Lisa Su, de Advanced Micro Devices Inc. ( AMD ), recibirán la Medalla Nacional de la Ciencia, según un funcionario de la Casa Blanca, que habló bajo condición de anonimato para compartir detalles sobre el evento. Michael Dell, fundador de Dell Technologies Inc. ( DELL ), y Satya Nadella, de Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ), recibirán la Medalla Nacional de Tecnología e Innovación. Ver más: Trump nombra a Clayton como zar de la IA en respuesta a inquietudes sobre seguridad La cumbre reunirá de nuevo a Trump con muchos de los principales líderes del sector tecnológico apenas una semana después de que los recibiera en la Casa Blanca para debatir las preocupaciones sobre el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial, tras una serie de brechas de seguridad de gran repercusión que avivaron los llamamientos a establecer medidas de protección más estrictas. Sin embargo, incluso antes de que diera comienzo esa reunión, Trump ya había descartado en gran medida la necesidad de medidas de seguridad más estrictas y, en su lugar, los ejecutivos acordaron un marco voluntario que prevé la colaboración con auditores externos para llevar a cabo evaluaciones de seguridad de los modelos avanzados. Trump se ha mostrado reacio a exigir nuevas regulaciones federales sobre la inteligencia artificial, abogando en su lugar por una mayor autorregulación y advirtiendo de que cualquier restricción podría suponer perder la carrera con China por desarrollar y aprovechar esta tecnología. Asimismo, ha firmado un decreto en el que ordena al poder ejecutivo que cambie la denominación de IA por “SI”, es decir, “superinteligencia”. Ver más: Trump rechaza nuevas leyes de seguridad para la IA tras reunirse con líderes de la industria Aunque Silicon Valley se mostró en gran medida receloso de Trump durante su primer mandato, los líderes del sector han acabado por aceptar muchas de sus políticas, ya que ha tomado medidas para reducir sus cargas fiscales y normativas y ha impulsado la inversión en áreas de vanguardia. La IA ha sido un tema de especial interés para el presidente, quien se ha erigido en defensor del sector a pesar de la inquietud de los votantes por su impacto en el empleo, los costes energéticos y el medio ambiente de cara a las elecciones de mitad de legislatura. “La administración Trump agradece las contribuciones de estos increíbles líderes en ciencia y tecnología. Estos galardonados están contribuyendo a garantizar que Estados Unidos siga liderando el mundo en materia de innovación”, declaró la portavoz de la Casa Blanca, Liz Huston, en un comunicado. Fox News Digital fue el primero en informar sobre los planes de Trump de premiar a estos líderes tecnológicos. Ver más: Trump se reúne con el CEO de Anthropic tras meses de choques por los riesgos de la IA La cumbre del jueves, denominada Ciencia: una nueva edad de oro, se celebra a raíz de un informe que el director de la Oficina de Política Científica y Tecnológica, Michael Kratsios, presentó a Trump en julio, en el que se destacaba el avance de la inteligencia artificial en EE.UU. La cumbre reunirá a destacados científicos e innovadores para debatir sobre la evolución de la IA, según el funcionario. En el acto, también se espera que Trump anuncie que National Compute, una empresa de inteligencia aplicada, donará US$100 millones en créditos informáticos para impulsar el descubrimiento científico, según declaró el funcionario. Politico fue el primero en informar sobre la donación. La administración Trump también anunciará planes para destinar más de US$100 millones a programas educativos para investigadores estadounidenses en los campos de las ciencias, la tecnología, la ingeniería y las matemáticas (STEM), según informó anteriormente Bloomberg. -Con la colaboración de Liam Knox. ＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロが急落した。財政懸念からフランス国債が改めて売り圧力にさらされたことが背景。ドルは直近の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）議事要旨公表後に上げを維持した。

マネックスＵＳＡ（ワシントン）のシニアトレーディングディレクター、フアン・ペレス氏は「欧州の問題は、しばらくの間、歳出を膨らませる一方で歳入をあまり増やさない福祉国家型の運営を続けてきたことで、それがついに重荷になってきた点だ。見通しは良くない」と述べた。

主要通貨バスケットに対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．３２％高の１０２．２４。ＦＯＭＣ議事要旨公表を受けて一時上昇幅を縮めたものの、その後持ち直した。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 米金融・債券市場では、国債利回りがこの日の高水準から低下した。原油価格の下落に加え、３９０億ドル規模の１０年債入札が好調な結果だったことから、投資家に安心感が広がった。

米国債には取引序盤、改めて売り圧力がかかった。原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドルを超えて上昇する中、インフレが想定以上に根強いとの懸念が再燃。指標の１０年債と３０年債の利回りは２４年ぶりの高水準を更新した。

しかしその後、３９０億ドルの１０年債入札が好調だったことで、米国債市場全体に買いが入った。長期国債に対する弱気な見方がここ数カ月続いていたことに加え、財政赤字拡大への懸念が再燃していたことから、一部投資家は需要が低調になることを懸念していた。

レイモンド・ジェームズ（メンフィス）の債券調査ディレクター、ビニー・ブロー氏は「１０年債がここまで売り込まれた中での良好な入札結果だった。買い手が入ってくるのを見るのは心強い。（売りを）恐れるか、それを好機と捉えて活用するかだ」と語った。

午後の取引で、指標の１０年債利回りは１．３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．２８４％となった。この日は一時、２４年ぶり高水準となる５．３６４％を付けていた。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 米国株式市場は反落。米長期債利回りが上昇する中、インフレと債務拡大を巡る懸念が再燃した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とダウ工業株３０種は５営業日ぶり、ナスダック総合は６営業日ぶりの反落となった。

小型株で構成するラッセル２０００は１．３％下落し、大型株をアンダーパフォームした。

北海ブレント先物の清算値は１バレル＝１００ドルを上回り、米長期債利回りは一時、２４年ぶりの高水準を付けた。

イラン戦争に伴う供給懸念で原油価格が高騰し、インフレ懸念が再燃するとともに、中央銀行による利上げサイクル長期化の可能性が高まっている。こうした懸念に企業や政府の債務拡大が重なって世界的な債券売りを招き、ここ数週間、各国市場を揺さぶっている。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 金相場は２カ月ぶりの安値まで下落した。ドル高と米金利の高止まりが背景。

１８１２ＧＭＴ（日本時間８日午前３時１２分）現在、スポット金は１オンス＝４１１３．８９ドル（１．２％安）まで下落し、８月５日以来の安値を付けた。米金先物１２月物の清算値は１．１％安の４１４０．７０ドル。

ドル指数は０．４％上昇し、ドル建ての金が他通貨保有者にとって割高となった。米１０年債利回りは２０年以上ぶりの高水準となっている。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 原油価格は不安定な値動きの末に下落した。国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は７日、中東情勢を背景にした燃料価格の高騰と供給混乱に対応するため、３月に開始した戦略石油備蓄放出を加速させるとともに、ディーゼル（軽油）の備蓄放出を優先する方針で合意した。

米ＷＴＩ先物の清算値は、前日比１．１６ドル（１．３％）安の１バレル＝８８．２８ドルだった。北海ブレント先物は０．３８ドル（０．３８％）安の１００．２０ドル。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

items.title: EE.UU. reduce su ayuda militar a América Latina pese al avance de gobiernos alineados con Trump
items.author: Maya Averbuch
items.summary: A pesar del renovado interés de Washington en la región, la ayuda militar a ocho de sus principales economías se redujo a tan solo US$56 millones el año pasado, el nivel más bajo desde al menos 2001.
items.body: Bloomberg — Donald Trump ha recortado la ayuda de EE.UU. a América Latina, incluso mientras un país tras otro ha elegido gobiernos alineados con él. A pesar del renovado interés de Washington en la región, la ayuda militar a ocho de sus principales economías se redujo a tan solo US$56 millones el año pasado, el nivel más bajo desde al menos 2001, según datos recopilados por Bloomberg Economics. Ver más: Cómo el costo de vida aleja a los latinos de Trump antes de las elecciones de medio término Flavio Bolsonaro, aliado de Trump, quedó primero en las elecciones presidenciales brasileñas del domingo y es el favorito para ganar la segunda vuelta del 25 de octubre contra el actual presidente, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Una victoria de Bolsonaro dejaría a México como la única gran economía regional no liderada por un gobierno alineado con Trump. Sin embargo, en lugar de financiar a gobiernos afines, Trump los está presionando para que aumenten sus presupuestos de defensa, compren armas estadounidenses y se unan a las operaciones lideradas por Estados Unidos contra los cárteles de la droga. Desde 2023, los aliados de Trump han ganado elecciones en toda América Latina, entre otros países, en Argentina, Chile, Perú y Colombia. El Gobierno socialista de Venezuela se ha realineado con Washington después de que las fuerzas estadounidenses capturaran al presidente Nicolás Maduro en enero. A Colombia, el mayor receptor de ayuda militar estadounidense en la región desde principios de la década de 2000, se le ha prometido nueva ayuda desde que el abogado de derechas Abelardo de la Espriella asumió el poder en agosto. Sin embargo, incluso los US$52 millones en financiación militar adicional que el Departamento de Estado tiene previsto repartir entre Colombia, Ecuador, Perú y Panamá no son más que una fracción de lo que recibió solo Colombia en el apogeo del Plan Colombia, el programa de lucha contra el narcotráfico y la insurgencia de la era Clinton que canalizó miles de millones de dólares en ayuda a la seguridad hacia Bogotá. Ver más: Trump firma decreto que flexibiliza el uso de diésel sin impuestos para reducir costos El contraste con las campañas estadounidenses anteriores es marcado. En el apogeo del Plan Colombia, Washington gastaba cientos de millones de dólares al año solo en Colombia en programas militares, policiales y de lucha contra el narcotráfico. “La financiación militar extranjera está pasada de moda. Las ventas de armamento al extranjero están de moda”, afirmó Henry Ziemer, investigador del Centro de Estudios Estratégicos e Internacionales en Washington. “Las exportaciones militares son una forma de revitalizar la base industrial estadounidense, pero no hay mucho interés en regalarlas. Estados Unidos quiere que otros paguen por ellas”. Aunque Trump ha rechazado el apoyo financiero, ha destinado recursos de otra forma mediante el despliegue de tropas en algunas situaciones. Catorce países latinoamericanos se han sumado al Escudo de las Américas de Trump, una alianza contra la delincuencia que puso en marcha en marzo. Varios países han acordado llevar a cabo operaciones conjuntas con EE.UU., según declaró en agosto el secretario de Defensa, Pete Hegseth. Tropas estadounidenses se han sumado recientemente a una redada policial en Ecuador y han recibido entrenamiento en Panamá para operaciones en la selva. Por otra parte, las fuerzas estadounidenses han matado a más de 220 personas en ataques contra embarcaciones que, según el ejército, transportaban drogas. El enfoque de Trump hacia América Latina ha sido bautizado como la “Doctrina Donroe”, un juego de palabras con la Doctrina Monroe, la política del siglo XIX que afirmaba el dominio estadounidense en el hemisferio occidental. “Los flujos de ayuda reales no han ido a la par con la retórica, al menos hasta ahora, en medio de una reducción generalizada de la ayuda exterior estadounidense”, dijo Jimena Zuniga de Bloomberg Economics. El Pentágono y el Departamento de Estado no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios. Las administraciones anteriores también se centraron en iniciativas económicas en la región, que en su punto álgido en 2012 aportaron apoyo de todo tipo a ocho de sus principales economías —incluido el sector militar— por un valor superior a los US$2.000 millones, ajustado a la inflación. El año pasado, esa cifra se redujo a casi la mitad: US$1.100 millones. Las consideraciones ideológicas no son el factor principal que determina qué países reciben el apoyo de EE.UU., según señaló Bloomberg Economics. México, que cuenta con un Gobierno de tendencia izquierdista, ha sido durante mucho tiempo un colaborador clave, a pesar de que la presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum ha rechazado en repetidas ocasiones cualquier operación militar extranjera en su país. Ver más: Los países de Latinoamérica donde más y menos aprueban la gestión internacional de Trump El Gobierno de Trump ha mostrado sus preferencias de otras formas, prometiendo apoyo financiero a Javier Milei, de Argentina, antes de unas elecciones cruciales, y sancionando a Brasil con aranceles después de que sus tribunales se negaran a retirar los cargos contra el expresidente Jair Bolsonaro por un intento de golpe de Estado. “Estados Unidos cuenta con otras herramientas para apoyar a sus aliados y presionar a quienes considera sus adversarios, como lo demuestran, respectivamente, el apoyo financiero a Argentina y los elevados aranceles impuestos a Brasil”, escribieron Zuniga y Courtney McBride de Bloomberg Economics. “Sin embargo, la evolución de los flujos de ayuda hasta el momento podría indicar limitaciones en la estrategia estadounidense”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: 独首相、極右への協力拒否呼びかけ　東部州議会でＡｆＤの議長ポスト獲得受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Miranda Murray

[ベルリン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Miranda Murray

[ベルリン ７日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は７日、東部ザクセン・アンハルト州議会で極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」所属のトビアス・ラウシュ議員が議長に選出されたことを受け、過激主義が議会に力強く入り込んでいると警告した。その上で各政治家に対し、ＡｆＤに協力しないよう呼びかけた。

背景には先月の同州議会選挙で第１党となったＡｆＤのラウシュ氏が６日に議長に選出された際、極左勢力や他党の議員らの支持も得たことが票数から示唆されたことがある。

ＡｆＤの躍進はメルツ政権への圧力を強めるとともに、主要政党がＡｆＤとの連立や政策実現のための協力を拒む慣行「防火壁（ファイアウォール）」の有効性を巡る議論を呼んでいる。投票は無記名だったため証拠はないものの、ＡｆＤがメルツ氏率いるキリスト教民主同盟（ＣＤＵ）に接近を図り、ＣＤＵ議員の一部がラウシュ氏を支持したのではないかとの憶測も浮上した。

メルツ氏は「ＡｆＤを支援した議員は過激派の思うつぼであり、政治への信頼を損なう。いずれにせよ、これは私の所属するＣＤＵの価値観と相いれない」と述べ、ＣＤＵ議員がＡｆＤ候補に投票したとの見方に異議を唱えた。

ラウシュ氏は４８票を獲得。ＡｆＤと左派ポピュリスト政党「ザーラ・ワーゲンクネヒト同盟（ＢＳＷ）」の議席数に基づく計４４票を上回っており、少なくとも４人の他党議員が支持した可能性がある。

メルツ氏は、無記名投票の経緯解明が可能かどうかは州議会各会派の判断に委ねられると述べる一方で「偽旗（フォールスフラッグ）工作」にも注意すべきだとして、性急な結論を避けるよう求めた。

さらにＡｆＤ、ＢＳＷと極左政党「左派党」を名指しして「ザクセン・アンハルト州議会には少なくとも２つ、いや３つの会派があり、民主主義の結束を損なおうとしている」と述べた。

連立与党を組む社会民主党（ＳＰＤ）はＣＤＵに説明を求めており、連邦議会のＳＰＤ会派トップ、マティアス・ミアーシュ氏は７日夜の連立協議でこの問題を取り上げる考えを示した。

items.title: What to Know About Suspected Plague Case in Siberia
items.summary:
Plague is one of history’s most feared diseases, responsible for pandemics that killed tens of millions of people. Today, human cases are rare and can usually be treated with antibiotics. A suspected case of pneumonic plague in Siberia has renewed attention on the disease after a young worker at a Russian institute that studies plague and other dangerous infections died of severe pneumonia. Russian authorities told the World Health Organization that no case of plague has been recorded in the region. Still, the circumstances of the woman’s death and the precautions taken afterward have prompted international scrutiny, with the WHO seeking more information from Russia.

We speak with Dr. Amesh Aldaja, Senior Scholar at the Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Padres closer Mason Miller returns from paternity list for Game 4
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The San Diego Padres activated All-Star closer Mason Miller from the paternity list prior to Wednesday night's Game 4 of the National League Division Series against the visiting Milwaukee Brewers.
items.body:
The San Diego Padres activated All-Star closer Mason Miller from the paternity list prior to Wednesday night's Game 4 of the National League Division Series against the visiting Milwaukee Brewers.
Miller was placed on the list Tuesday, hours before the Padres recorded a 4-3 victory to remain alive in the best-of-five series. Starting pitcher Michael King filled Miller's closing role with two shutout innings.
"Everything went well so far with him and his wife and he should be back," Padres manager Craig Stammen told reporters shortly before the Padres officially announced Miller's return.
The right-handed Miller blew the save in Game 2 on Sunday when the Padres fell 4-3 in Milwaukee. He was asked to get six outs for the first time all season and he was able to get only five before serving up Jackson Chourio's game-winning, two-run single.
Left-handed setup man Adrian Morejon (shoulder) is expected back Wednesday after being unavailable in Game 3.
The Padres removed left-hander Wandy Peralta from the roster for Miller's return. Miller is 0-1 with one save and a 6.75 ERA in two appearances this postseason.
San Diego right-hander Walker Buehler (9-6, 4.83 ERA in the regular season) and left-hander Robert Gasser (5-5, 3.87) are the Game 4 starters.
Gasser was in the Padres' system before being traded to the Brewers in August 2022 as part of the package in which left-handed reliever Josh Hader went to San Diego. Gasser has never faced his former team.
Milwaukee leads the series 2-1 and can wrap it up with a victory Wednesday in San Diego.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Hegseth praises sailors' resilience after record-breaking carrier deployment
items.author: Phil Stewart
items.creator: Phil Stewart
items.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth flew to the flight deck of the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln on Wednesday and praised the resilience of sailors who endured an extended, wartime deployment that drew scrutiny over suicide attempts on board.
items.body:
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth flew to the flight deck of the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln on Wednesday and praised the resilience of sailors who endured an extended, wartime deployment that drew scrutiny over suicide attempts on board.
The Lincoln, which is due to dock on Thursday in San Diego, is the flagship of a carrier strike group that had [USN:L1N45G0IP TEXT:"eight suicide attempts"] among US sailors during its time at sea, according to the Navy. Its deployment included more than 260 continuous days without a port call, a record, according to the Pentagon.
Hegseth, whose speeches regularly target the media, accused reporters of trying to turn the crew of the Lincoln strike group into symbols of dysfunction or of a failed mission instead of heroes of the conflict, and presented a citation from President Donald Trump for their achievements during the Iran war.
The Lincoln's accomplishments included sinking 64 Iranian warships, destroying 21 anti-ship cruise missiles, executing 3,693 combat sorties, launching 450 Tomahawk land attack cruise missiles and firing 1.37 million pounds of ordnance against Iran, Hegseth said.
Despite the fast pace of combat operations, it suffered no casualties and had no aircraft mishaps, Hegseth said.
"What makes the US military and the US Navy and all these sailors different is that you adapt and that you're resilient and you overcome - you finish the mission nonetheless," Hegseth told the crew. "Yes, it's hard. That's why you're here. You do difficult and hard things."
Typically naval deployments are for between six and nine months but can be extended during times of conflict. Mental health issues on long deployments have long challenged the US Navy.
In August, amid reports of low morale and supply shortages on board, Trump was asked whether he thought the Lincoln had been deployed too long. Trump responded: "No, no, no. Not nearly long enough."
Hegseth acknowledged some challenges on board, saying "there wasn't an easy resupply."
Ahead of the carrier's return to port, Hegseth joked that he was "the only thing standing between you and home" and that he was also the one who signed the orders repeatedly extending the deployment.
"You deserve to see your families and see them as soon as possible," Hegseth said, adding he just wanted to see them for "a moment on the route, on the way in, just to say thank you."
The carrier's return comes at a crossroads in the US-Iran war, which has jolted global energy markets and become a political liability for Trump and fellow Republicans ahead of November midterm elections .
The war — and its [USN:L6N4530XO TEXT:"$3 billion monthly price tag"] — has become a key issue on the campaign trail. Higher energy prices have put Trump and Republicans on the defensive in competitive states that will decide control of Congress.
Trump is weighing next steps against Iran, including whether to escalate strikes before or after the elections, as he presses a naval blockade meant to pile economic pressure on Tehran to reach a deal to end the conflict.
Vice President JD Vance [USN:L6N45S099 TEXT:"told Reuters"] on Monday that Iran must make a "meaningful" reduction in its uranium enrichment capacity to satisfy US demands and end the countries' seven-month war.
Hegseth said the crew of the Lincoln had helped ensure the US objective of preventing Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon.
"You have changed the arc of history," he told them on Wednesday.

items.title: Trump floats turning his Florida golf course into presidential retreat
items.author: Christian Martinez, Bo Erickson
items.creator: Christian Martinez, Bo Erickson
items.summary: US President Donald Trumpon Wednesday backed a plan to turn part of his West Palm Beach, Florida, golf course into a Camp David-style presidential retreat.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump on Wednesday backed a plan to turn part of his West Palm Beach, Florida, golf course into a Camp David-style presidential retreat.
"It's a great idea, and it will be used a lot," Trump told reporters on Wednesday when asked about the plan.
"The advantage is — this was suggested to me by the military and Secret Service — there are no high buildings looming over it," Trump told reporters. He also noted the location's proximity to the recently renamed President Donald J. Trump International Airport and a lack of nearby housing.
"They asked if I'd be willing to do it, and I said I would be," Trump said. "This wouldn't be for me. This would be for all future presidents."
The club was the site of a foiled assassination attempt on Trump in 2024. Ryan Routh was [USN:L6N3YZ0D3 TEXT:"sentenced to life in prison"] in February after prosecutors said he hid in bushes near the course with a semi-automatic rifle. Secret Service agents captured him before he could fire a shot.
The Palm Beach Post first reported that a lawyer representing Trump International Golf Club proposed the idea in a letter last month to Palm Beach County officials. The plan would designate a parcel of the club as a permanent location for presidents and world leaders, the newspaper said. Reuters could not immediately confirm the letter's contents.
An attorney representing the club told the Washington Post that Trump would pay for construction of the presidential residence and facilities.
The US Secret Service and Department of Defense did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
(This story has refiled to remove the extraneous word 'secret' in paragraph 5.)

items.title: Prefeito francês flagrado em vídeo viral de confronto diz que estudantes manifestantes “podiam ser meus filhos”
items.author: Layli Foroudi
items.creator: Layli Foroudi
items.summary: Em um vídeo que se tornou viral nas redes sociais, Bally Bagayoko, prefeito da cidade francesa de Saint-Denis, aparece de frente para a polícia durante uma marcha em Paris na terça-feira, protegendo jovens manifestantes e gritando “parem”.
items.body:
Em um vídeo que se tornou viral nas redes sociais, Bally Bagayoko, prefeito da cidade francesa de Saint-Denis, aparece de frente para a polícia durante uma marcha em Paris na terça-feira, protegendo jovens manifestantes e gritando “parem”.
Bagayoko disse que vem apoiando os estudantes em seu subúrbio parisiense de classe trabalhadora e que, na terça-feira, pediu à polícia que não avançasse.
“Eles decidiram avançar e, de fato, perseguir os estudantes, muitos dos quais não haviam demonstrado qualquer comportamento agressivo em relação aos policiais”, disse Bagayoko, que faz parte do partido de extrema-esquerda França Insubmissa (LFI), à Reuters em uma entrevista nesta quarta-feira em seu gabinete na prefeitura de Saint-Denis, na periferia norte de Paris.
No fim, a polícia lançou gás lacrimogêneo contra o grupo, incluindo o prefeito, disse ele.
A onda de protestos estudantis, que começou nos subúrbios marginalizados de Paris, já dura mais de duas semanas e revelou uma indignação pública generalizada a seis meses das eleições para substituir o presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron.
Houve mais de 6.000 prisões e dezenas de estudantes feridos desde o início dos protestos. Grupos de direitos humanos e sindicatos acusam a polícia de usar táticas repressivas contra menores, incluindo o uso de cassetetes, gás lacrimogêneo e armas não letais do tipo “flashball”. As autoridades afirmam que centenas de policiais também ficaram feridos, escolas foram incendiadas ou saqueadas, e professores e cidadãos foram atacados.
A cidade de Saint-Denis, onde os índices de pobreza são mais do que o dobro da média nacional, foi um dos primeiros locais dos protestos estudantis no final de setembro contra salas de aula superlotadas e insalubres, falta de professores e desigualdade de oportunidades.
“Os protestos não são novidade por aqui, acontecem sempre no início do ano letivo”, disse Bagayoko. “A promessa republicana (de igualdade) — especialmente para os bairros da classe trabalhadora e também para as áreas rurais — não está sendo respeitada.”
Ele afirmou que o governo deveria priorizar o investimento em educação e cobrar impostos mais pesados dos bilionários.
O primeiro-ministro francês, Sébastien Lecornu, disse nesta quarta-feira que o governo analisaria as reivindicações dos estudantes e apresentaria propostas no final de outubro, mas não deu detalhes.
O governo sugeriu que políticos do LFI estariam por trás dos protestos, uma acusação que Bagayoko rejeitou como insultuosa aos jovens manifestantes.
Pai de quatro filhos, ele disse que “os alunos do ensino médio que estavam nas ruas poderiam ser meus filhos... é minha responsabilidade estar ao lado deles”.

items.title: FBI arrests man for plotting mass shooting at Mall of America
items.author: Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff
items.creator: Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff
items.summary: The FBI has arrested an 18-year-old man who had been plotting to carry out a mass shooting at the Mall of America near Minneapolis in the name of ISIS, according to court filings.
items.body:
The FBI has arrested an 18-year-old man who had been plotting to carry out a mass shooting at the Mall of America near Minneapolis in the name of ISIS, according to court filings.
He was arrested on Tuesday after an FBI undercover agent sold the Minnesota man, Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, an AK-47, ammunition and magazines for $600, according to the complaint. Mohamud told the informant he planned to use the items to kill 30 to 60 people at an event at the mall in late October.
Mohamud was charged with one count of knowingly receiving a firearm and ammunition in order to commit an act of terrorism. His lawyer did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
According to the complaint, Mohamud told an FBI source on various messaging platforms that he intended to travel overseas to fight on behalf of al-Shabaab, a designated foreign terrorist organization. He said if he couldn't travel, he planned to conduct a mass shooting. He later said he wanted to join ISIS.
He also allegedly expressed support for a man who rammed a truck into a crowd in New Orleans on January 1, 2025, killing 14, before being killed in a shootout with police.
In July, Mohamud allegedly said he wanted to kill 30 to 60 people at the Mall of America because he claimed its owners were Jewish, and he wanted to kill non-Muslims. He told the informant he planned an attack for October 24 because there was a "Hmong Arts Celebration" that day at the mall.
The Mall of America is the largest mall in the United States, with a theme park, an aquarium and more than 500 stores.
On Tuesday, Mohamud allegedly bought the AK-47, four 30-round-capacity magazines and about 200 rounds of ammunition from an FBI undercover agent. Soon after, FBI agents arrested him.
Mohamud made his initial court appearance before US Magistrate Judge Elizabeth Cowan Wright on Wednesday.

Oct 7 : TikTok ran an experiment on thousands of users who tried to turn on a safety feature on the platform, giving them non-functional versions of the tool, according to allegations in New York’s lawsuit against the company unsealed on Wednesday.
In the so-called “ghost” or placebo experiments, TikTok selected thousands of users, including teens and children, who opted to use safety features like “Algo Refresh,” a tool designed to reset recommendations for users seeking to escape unwanted or potentially harmful content. According to the lawsuit, those users believed they had activated the feature, but their feeds did not change, unlike users who got the fully working version.
The newly unsealed allegations are part of New York Attorney General Letitia James’ lawsuit against the company, one of more than two dozen brought by states accusing TikTok of designing its platform to addict children and of misleading users about its safety. Many documents in state cases across the country have been sealed or heavily redacted as TikTok has sought to keep details about its operations from public view.
The lawsuit claims TikTok assures users that safety is a top priority and that its platform is appropriate for kids and teens, while knowingly preventing some groups of users from accessing certain safety tools, including users who had specifically sought to avoid unwanted or potentially harmful content.

"We continuously make improvements to our platform which means that, like most companies, we regularly test new products and features to validate the experience and understand how they work in the real world," a TikTok spokesperson said in a statement.
The company has broadly denied New York's allegations in court filings and has said that keeping young users safe is a priority.
In September, TikTok settled the first state lawsuit set for trial, agreeing to pay Alabama up to $300 million and change how its platform functions for teens in the state.
James, a Democrat, originally sued in 2024. The claims about the tests were included in an updated, sealed version of New York’s complaint filed at the end of August and later ordered unsealed by a judge. 
EMPLOYEE FLAGGED TEST
Internally, a product manager for Digital Well Being at TikTok, said doing placebo tests on the Algo Refresh feature was problematic and that users might find it misleading, the lawsuit alleges.
“This feature is about algorithm transparency and control,” the person wrote in an internal chat, according to the lawsuit. “A placebo group completely conflicts with that.” 
Ultimately the company did the tests repeatedly on thousands of users in 2023, comparing users who did not get the feature with those who did, to study how long users stayed on the site and the impact on ad revenue, the lawsuit alleges.
The lawsuit also alleges that TikTok misled consumers about how “Algo Refresh” worked, telling them it would reset the algorithm that recommended videos to them when it was only a temporary change. The TikTok spokesperson said the allegations mischaracterize how "Algo Refresh" works.
The unsealed portions of the lawsuit also allege that TikTok conducted a separate set of experiments, which were previously revealed in a report by Bloomberg. In them, TikTok randomly selected users and turned off safety features on their accounts that limited their exposure to harmful content. A teen boy in New York who was part of the test committed suicide after he was shown content about self-harm and suicide, Bloomberg reported.
Internal reviews showed the boy had been shown an “onslaught” of content about suicide and self-harm, the lawsuit said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Milho e soja recuam em Chicago com avanço da colheita nos EUA
items.author: Julie Ingwersen
items.creator: Julie Ingwersen
items.summary: Os contratos futuros de milho e soja de Chicago recuaram em relação às máximas de uma semana nesta quarta-feira, pressionados pelo avanço da colheita no Meio-Oeste dos EUA, pelo dólar forte e pela incerteza antes dos relatórios mensais de oferta e demanda agrícola que serão divulgados pelo Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA nesta sexta-feira, segundo analistas.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros de milho e soja de Chicago recuaram em relação às máximas de uma semana nesta quarta-feira, pressionados pelo avanço da colheita no Meio-Oeste dos EUA, pelo dólar forte e pela incerteza antes dos relatórios mensais de oferta e demanda agrícola que serão divulgados pelo Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA nesta sexta-feira, segundo analistas.
Os futuros do trigo recuaram mais de 2% devido a vendas técnicas e à incerteza sobre a demanda, à medida que a moeda norte-americana se fortaleceu.
O contrato de milho para dezembro fechou em queda de 6 centavos, ou 1,2%, a US$5,02 o bushel, e o contrato de soja para novembro encerrou com queda de 5,50 centavos, ou 0,4%, a US$12,975 o bushel.
O contrato de trigo de dezembro fechou em queda de 17,75 centavos, ou 2,5%, a US$6,865 por bushel.
O milho e a soja recuaram à medida que as colheitadeiras avançavam pelo Meio-Oeste sob um céu predominantemente claro, ampliando os trabalhos no campo após as fortes chuvas do final de setembro terem atrasado o andamento das atividades. Os mercados à vista do Meio-Oeste para ambas as culturas permaneceram fracos nesta semana, com o aumento das vendas por parte dos agricultores.
"Estamos entrando em uma fase de colheita intensa aqui", disse Don Roose, presidente da U.S. Commodities, com sede em Iowa, acrescentando que os participantes do mercado estavam acompanhando os relatórios de rendimento dos campos antes dos relatórios de oferta e demanda do USDA, que incluirão estimativas atualizadas para os EUA.
Analistas consultados pela Reuters esperam, em média, que o USDA reduza na sexta-feira sua estimativa do rendimento médio do milho nos EUA, mantendo inalterada a previsão para a produtividade da soja.

items.title: Maduro enfrentará novas acusações dos EUA por suposta tortura de norte-americanos, diz autoridade
items.author: Andrew Goudsward, Luc Cohen
items.creator: Andrew Goudsward, Luc Cohen
items.summary: O ex-presidente venezuelano Nicolás Maduro e sua esposa, Cilia Flores, devem enfrentar novas acusações criminais nos EUA por supostas torturas contra cidadãos norte-americanos detidos naquele país sul-americano, afirmou uma autoridade norte-americana nesta quarta-feira.
items.body:
O ex-presidente venezuelano Nicolás Maduro e sua esposa, Cilia Flores, devem enfrentar novas acusações criminais nos EUA por supostas torturas contra cidadãos norte-americanos detidos naquele país sul-americano, afirmou uma autoridade norte-americana nesta quarta-feira.
As novas acusações podem ser apresentadas já na quinta-feira, segundo a autoridade, que foi informada sobre a investigação.
Maduro e Flores foram capturados por forças dos EUA em suas residências em Caracas no dia 3 de janeiro e levados para Nova York para responder a acusações de tráfico de drogas. Eles se declararam inocentes.
Um porta-voz da procuradoria federal de Manhattan, que apresentou as acusações, se recusou a comentar.
Os advogados de Maduro e Flores não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário.
A possibilidade de novas acusações foi divulgada pela primeira vez pela CNN nesta quarta-feira.
Detalhes das novas acusações, incluindo as identidades das supostas vítimas de tortura, não foram divulgados imediatamente.
Os 13 anos de Maduro no poder na Venezuela, país rico em petróleo, foram marcados por tensões com os Estados Unidos. Washington afirmou que vários de seus cidadãos foram detidos injustamente no país sul-americano durante seu mandato.
Desde a captura de Maduro, a Venezuela tem sido liderada por sua ex-vice-presidente, Delcy Rodríguez, que intensificou a cooperação com o governo Trump.

items.title: Financiera Adventus Capital realiza la primera emisión simplificada de deuda en la Bolsa Mexicana
items.author: Italia López
items.summary: La sociedad financiera de objeto múltiple (sofom) especializada en financiamiento empresarial y estructurado colocó MXN$560 millones.
items.body: Ciudad de México — La financiera no bancaria Adventus Capital se convirtió en la primera emisora simplificada de la Bolsa Mexicana de Valores (BMV) al colocar deuda por MXN$560 millones (US$31 millones) bajo este esquema. Esta emisión simplificada se compone de una bursatilización que incorpora derechos de cobro derivados de un crédito que fue otorgado al estado de Michoacán, respaldado por participaciones federales. La sociedad financiera de objeto múltiple (sofom) especializada en financiamiento empresarial y estructurado realizó este 7 de octubre la emisión con Altor Casa de Bolsa como intermediario colocador. La operación consistió en la oferta de 5,6 millones de Certificados Bursátiles Fiduciarios de Largo Plazo, con clave de pizarra CEFI+CB 26 y valor nominal de MXN$100 cada uno. Ver más: Regulador en México pide a inversionistas institucionales participar en emisiones simplificadas “Esta primera colocación simplificada abre una nueva puerta al mercado de valores, con un proceso más ágil y con menor costo. Es un paso concreto para acercar el financiamiento bursátil a más empresas y acompañarlas en sus planes de crecimiento”, dijo Marcos Martínez, presidente del Consejo de Administración del Grupo Bolsa Mexicana de Valores, en un comunicado. La emisión tiene las calificaciones “HR AAA (E)” con HR Ratings y “AAA/M (e)” con Verum, el nivel más alto en ambas escalas. El esquema de emisión simplificada, surgió tras las reformas a las leyes del Mercado de Valores y de Fondos de Inversión en 2023, con el fin de incrementar el acceso de las pequeñas y medianas empresas (pymes) al mercado bursátil. Sin embargo fue hasta 2025 que se emitieron las disposiciones y otras normativas necesarias para utilizar la figura. Los listados de deuda o capital bajo estos esquemas son más rápidos y más baratos que el listado tradicional, y solo los inversionistas institucionales o calificados, como las administradoras de fondos para el retiro (afore), pueden participar en las ofertas.

items.title: General Dynamics taps insider Danny Deep as next CEO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: General Dynamics on Wednesday said President Danny Deep would take over as CEO in January, succeeding longtime chief executive Phebe Novakovic.
items.body:
General Dynamics (GD.N) on Wednesday said President Danny Deep would take over as CEO in January, succeeding longtime chief executive Phebe Novakovic.
The leadership transition comes at a time of sustained demand for the company's defense and aerospace products, which range from Gulfstream jets and submarines to combat vehicles and IT services.
Here are more details:
Deep held senior leadership roles across General Dynamics' land systems, combat systems and global operations businesses before being named president in 2025
Novakovic, who will become executive chairman, has been General Dynamics' CEO since 2013, steering the company through a decade of growth and rising global defense spending
The defense contractor [USN:L4N43V11A TEXT:"reported"] profit of $4.24 per share for the quarter ended July 5, above analysts' estimate of $3.97, according to data compiled by LSEG

items.title: Saudi-Led Forces Claim Ground Advances Against Houthis in Yemen
items.summary:
Yemen’s internationally-recognized government, backed by Saudi Arabia, claimed to have regained territory from the Houthis, as fighting in the region near the Bab el-Mandeb strait intensifies. The Yemeni armed forces said they took control of the Red Sea city of Mokha on Monday after battles with the Iran-backed Houthis, according to Saba, a Yemeni news agency. Overnight, the Houthis said the Saudi Arabian military had launched around 60 airstrikes on parts of Yemen, including the capital, Sanaa. The Houthis said they responded by firing missiles and drones at the kingdom, and targeted the main airport in Riyadh.

For a closer look, we speak with Jennifer Welch, Chief Geoeconomics Analyst for Bloomberg Economics. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels to 'embrace the brace,' play vs. Giants
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels was a full participant in practice Wednesday, another step toward his return from a left elbow injury.
items.body:
Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels was a full participant in practice Wednesday, another step toward his return from a left elbow injury.
Daniels hurt his non-throwing arm on the final play of the first half in Week 2 against the Dallas Cowboys and traveled with the Commanders (1-3) to London last week. He was limited in every practice before the loss to the Indianapolis Colts, when starter Marcus Mariota went down with a sprained knee.
Rookie Athan Kaliakmanis replaced Mariota, but Daniels took the reps in Wednesday's practice. Head coach Dan Quinn confirmed he plans to start Daniels this week against the visiting New York Giants (3-1), barring any setbacks.
"The goal is for him to have a full week of practice and start on Sunday," Quinn said. "We won't put him out there before he's ready."
Part of getting ready was beginning work in Wednesday's practice on protecting his elbow. Quinn said there are some adjustments for Daniels to make and others for the team to address.
Daniels wore a brace on his left elbow and plans to keep it on for game day.
"I'm gonna embrace the brace," Daniels said. "Go out there and be the best version of myself."
Daniels, 25, missed time last season with the same injury and was forced to exit his first game back in 2025 after spraining the same elbow. He played a total of only seven games last season due to multiple injuries.
He has completed only 57% of his passes this season (29 of 51) but has three touchdowns and no turnovers in six quarters of game action in 2026. He is 3-0 in his career against the Giants.
"Just putting in the countless hours of work and preparation," Daniels said. "Just go out there and give myself the best opportunity to perform to the best of my ability on Sunday."
The Commanders hosted former United Football League MVP quarterback Jack Plummer on Wednesday morning, according to the league transactions log.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump diz que merece Prêmio Nobel da Paz, mas tem dúvidas sobre suas chances
items.author: Doina Chiacu, Bo Erickson
items.creator: Doina Chiacu, Bo Erickson
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, que trava uma guerra contra o Irã e ainda não conseguiu negociar a paz na Ucrânia, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que deveria ganhar o Prêmio Nobel da Paz, mas reconheceu ter dúvidas quanto às suas chances.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, que trava uma guerra contra o Irã e ainda não conseguiu negociar a paz na Ucrânia, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que deveria ganhar o Prêmio Nobel da Paz, mas reconheceu ter dúvidas quanto às suas chances.
“Não sei qual será a decisão deles”, disse Trump sobre o prêmio de 2026, que o Comitê Norueguês do Nobel anunciará na sexta-feira. “Eles têm a reputação de talvez não concedê-lo a pessoas como eu.”
Desde seu retorno à Casa Branca no ano passado, Trump tem afirmado repetidamente que merece o que talvez seja o prêmio mais prestigiado do mundo.
“Já está na hora”, disse Trump aos repórteres no Salão Oval. “Mas fiquei muito honrado por recebê-lo indiretamente da última vez, por meio do ganhador, que disse que ninguém na história merece mais do que o presidente Trump.”
A líder da oposição venezuelana María Corina Machado entregou sua medalha do Prêmio Nobel da Paz de 2025 a Trump em janeiro, enquanto buscava o apoio dos EUA para seus esforços na Venezuela.
Trump afirmou que deveria receber o prêmio por ter se envolvido em oito conflitos desde que assumiu o cargo em janeiro passado.
Os líderes do Camboja, de Israel e do Paquistão afirmaram ter indicado Trump, embora não haja como verificar isso.
As partes envolvidas em alguns dos conflitos que Trump alega ter resolvido contestam o papel diplomático do presidente dos EUA, e os combates recomeçaram em algumas dessas regiões, incluindo a República Democrática do Congo e ao longo da fronteira entre o Camboja e a Tailândia.
Uma solução para a guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia tem escapado a Trump, que prometeu encerrá-la no primeiro dia de seu segundo mandato na Casa Branca. Os ataques dos EUA e de Israel ao Irã levaram a um conflito latente de sete meses que abalou o abastecimento global de energia e elevou os preços da gasolina antes das eleições de meio de mandato de novembro.
O papa Leão 14, o Tribunal Penal Internacional e o relator especial para os Territórios Palestinos estão entre os favoritos para vencer este ano.
