items.title: Petrobras arremata 19 blocos em leilão de concessão por R$3 bi
items.author: Marta Nogueira, Rodrigo Viga Gaier
items.creator: Marta Nogueira, Rodrigo Viga Gaier
items.summary: A Petrobras arrematou 19 dos 49 blocos exploratórios de petróleo e gás ofertados em leilão de Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP), em regime de concessão, nesta quarta-feira, com a oferta de aproximadamente R$3 bilhões em bônus de assinatura.
items.body:
A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) arrematou 19 dos 49 blocos exploratórios de petróleo e gás ofertados em leilão de Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP), em regime de concessão, nesta quarta-feira, com a oferta de aproximadamente R$3 bilhões em bônus de assinatura.
A empresa respondeu por quase a totalidade do valor arrecadado à União na rodada.
Dos 19 blocos, a petroleira estatal levou sozinha 12 áreas na Bacia de Campos, dos quais cinco em disputas com um consórcio formado por TotalEnergies e QatarEnergy. Dois desses blocos responderam por metade de toda a arrecadação da rodada.
"Fomos atrás da Bacia de Campos porque enxergamos ali potencial para coisa nova e com elevado potencial... A compra das áreas explica esse interesse", disse uma fonte da Petrobras, que preferiu ficar no anonimato, à Reuters.
Os maiores bônus de assinatura do leilão foram pagos pela Petrobras, no valor de R$754,197 milhões, por cada um dos blocos C-M-115 e C-M-161, na Bacia de Campos, ambos com ágio de mais de 21.000%.
Os sete demais blocos a Petrobras arrematou como operadora, com 70% de participação, em consórcio com a QatarEnergy, na Bacia do Ceará.
Tanto em Campos como no Ceará, a Petrobras foi a única operadora a levar áreas.
O leilão ofertou mais de 300 blocos em diversas bacias. Dentre elas também estavam Potiguar, Recôncavo, Parnaíba, Ceará, Espírito Santo e Tucano Sul.
A petroleira Eneva arrematou seis blocos na Bacia do Parnaíba, onde já concentra uma importante produção de gás em diversas áreas. PetroRecôncavo arrematou dois blocos, nas bacias de Potiguar e Recôncavo.
Entre as independentes, a companhia Aguila foi o destaque em número de áreas, com 12 blocos, espalhados entre Potiguar, Recôncavo e Tacutu.
O leilão inteiro arrecadou pouco mais de R$3 bilhões. Um dos blocos foi arrematado após o término do leilão, quando as companhias tiveram uma nova oportunidade para fazer lances.
Mais cedo, a ANP [USN:L6N45T0UZ TEXT:"também negociou"] outros sete blocos exploratórios de petróleo e gás, em um leilão de partilha do pré-sal, um número recorde diário para vendas de áreas na importante região produtora, com empresas como a Petrobras, Prio e a norueguesa Equinor buscando garantir ativos próximos de onde já operam.

items.title: Venezuela's Maduro to face new US charges over alleged torture of Americans, official says
items.author: Andrew Goudsward, Luc Cohen
items.creator: Andrew Goudsward, Luc Cohen
items.summary: Ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores are expected to face new criminal charges in the United States over allegations that Americans detained in Venezuela were tortured, a US official said on Wednesday.
items.body:
Ousted Venezuelan President [USN:L6N44P07P TEXT:"Nicolas Maduro"] and his wife Cilia Flores are expected to face new criminal charges in the United States over allegations that Americans detained in Venezuela were tortured, a US official said on Wednesday.
The new charges could come as soon as Thursday, according to the official, who was briefed on the investigation.
Maduro, who led Venezuela for 13 years, and Flores were captured by the US military from their home in Caracas on January 3 and brought to New York to face drug trafficking charges. They have pleaded not guilty and are scheduled to go on trial [USN:L6N43O0Z4 TEXT:"starting June 1"], 2027.
A spokesperson for the Manhattan US Attorney's office, which brought the charges, declined to comment.
Lawyers for Maduro and Flores did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The possibility of new charges was first reported by CNN on Wednesday.
Details of the new charges, including the identities of the alleged torture victims, were not immediately available.
Maduro's tenure was marked by tensions with the United States. Washington accused his government of detaining Americans as leverage to extract concessions such as relief from financial sanctions.
Americans whom the US classified as wrongfully detained during Maduro's tenure included five oil executives arrested on graft charges. They were [USN:L1N3120I8 TEXT:"freed in 2022"] in exchange for two of Flores' nephews who had been convicted in the US of drug trafficking.
Others detained included two former US Army Special Forces members who were arrested in Venezuela in 2020 in connection with a botched raid aimed at ousting Maduro. They were [USN:S0N3BU02L TEXT:"freed in 2023"] as part of another prisoner swap.
Since Maduro's capture, Venezuela has been led by his former vice president, Delcy Rodriguez, who has increased cooperation with the Trump administration.
Maduro, 63, and Flores, 69, have been held in a federal jail in Brooklyn.
Flores is due to appear in Manhattan federal court on Thursday to urge US District Judge Alvin Hellerstein to release her from jail before trial for health reasons. Prosecutors oppose her release.

items.title: Wall Street fecha  em baixa, com rendimentos do Tesouro em alta
items.author: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
items.summary: Wall Street fechou em baixa nesta quarta-feira, à medida que os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA de longo prazo retomaram sua alta, reacendendo os temores sobre a inflação e o aumento da dívida, um dia após o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq atingirem recordes de fechamento.
items.body:
Wall Street fechou em baixa nesta quarta-feira, à medida que os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA de longo prazo retomaram sua alta, reacendendo os temores sobre a inflação e o aumento da dívida, um dia após o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq atingirem recordes de fechamento.
Os três principais índices acionários dos EUA registraram quedas modestas, com o S&P 500 e o Dow Jones encerrando sequências de quatro dias de alta. O Nasdaq registrou seu primeiro dia de queda em seis.
O Russell 2000, índice de pequenas capitalizações (.RUT) , apresentou desempenho inferior ao das empresas de maior capitalização, caindo 1,3%.
Na esteira da alta do mercado de ações na terça-feira, o petróleo Brent ultrapassou brevemente a marca de US$100 por barril, e o rendimento dos títulos do Tesouro de longo prazo atingiu a maior alta em 24 anos.
Preocupações com o abastecimento relacionadas à guerra no Irã têm levado à alta vertiginosa dos preços do petróleo, o que, por sua vez, reacendeu os temores de inflação e aumentou as chances de um ciclo prolongado de aumentos nas taxas de juros pelo banco central. Essas preocupações, combinadas com os crescentes níveis de endividamento corporativo e soberano, causaram uma onda de vendas de títulos globais, o que abalou os mercados globais nas últimas semanas.
Os investidores “vêm buscando algum alívio no preço do petróleo, o que traria algum alívio nas taxas e, portanto, ajudaria o mercado de ações”, disse Thomas Martin, gestor sênior de carteiras da GLOBALT em Atlanta.
“O terceiro trimestre deveria ter sido o trimestre mais fraco do ano; esperávamos uma correção”, acrescentou Martin. “Isso não aconteceu, então vamos comemorar e realizar alguns lucros.”
As ações reduziram as perdas depois que os preços do petróleo bruto caíram, na sequência do acordo da Agência Internacional de Energia para acelerar a liberação de estoques de petróleo, priorizando o diesel.
A ata da reunião de política monetária de setembro do Federal Reserve, na qual o banco central aprovou por unanimidade seu primeiro aumento da taxa de juros desde julho de 2023, revelou divergências quanto à justificativa do aumento. Alguns participantes consideraram o aumento necessário para conter o impacto dos choques nos preços da energia, enquanto outros acharam que o aumento era necessário para conter a inflação impulsionada pela demanda.
Atualmente, os mercados financeiros estão precificando uma probabilidade de 17,2% de que o Fed implemente um segundo aumento consecutivo das taxas ao final de sua reunião de outubro, uma queda em relação aos 37,6% registrados há uma semana, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME.
“As expectativas do mercado em relação ao Fed vão oscilar à medida que novos dados forem surgindo”, disse Martin. “Ainda há expectativa de mais aumentos nas taxas, mas não será necessariamente um aumento a cada reunião, e é isso que o mercado está indicando; outubro será uma pausa.”
O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,66%, para 51.180,17 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,22%, para 7.801,75 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 0,22%, para 27.538,69 pontos.
Entre os 11 setores do S&P 500, o setor industrial (.SPLRCI) sofreu a maior queda percentual, enquanto as ações do setor de saúde (.SPXHC) lideraram os ganhos.
Na esteira da alta nos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro de referência, a taxa fixa de hipotecas de 30 anos disparou na semana passada para o maior nível em quase três anos, de acordo com a associação do setor hipotecário dos EUA Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA). O setor imobiliário (.HGX) e as construtoras (.SPCOMHOME) recuaram 2,3% e 2,9%, respectivamente.
As ações de empresas de chips (.SOX) , que subiram mais de 80% neste ano, caíram 1,2%.
A SpaceX (SPCX.O) perdeu 2,5% após reportagens da mídia indicarem que a empresa aeroespacial de Elon Musk estava buscando US$40 bilhões em financiamento para custear a compra de chips da Nvidia.
Na próxima semana, espera-se que a temporada de divulgação dos resultados do terceiro trimestre comece para valer, com uma série de grandes bancos prestes a divulgar seus resultados.
É provável que os investidores analisem minuciosamente até que ponto os gastos maciços com tecnologia de IA estão começando a mostrar resultados, ao mesmo tempo em que ficam atentos a indícios sobre a saúde do consumidor norte-americano em um momento de crescentes pressões inflacionárias.
Atualmente, os analistas esperam um crescimento dos lucros do S&P 500 de 30,6% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior, de forma agregada, para o período de julho a setembro, de acordo com a LSEG.

items.title: Fed minutes show some officials want to prepare for market stress
items.author: Michael Derby
items.creator: Michael Derby
items.summary: Federal Reserve meeting minutes from last month’s policy meeting noted some officials believe it’s time for the central bank to get ready for bond market stress.
items.body:
Federal Reserve meeting minutes from last month’s policy meeting noted some officials believe it’s time for the central bank to get ready for bond market stress.
“Regarding balance sheet policy, a few participants observed that Treasury markets had been functioning smoothly but noted the importance of planning for market stress,” the [USN:L6N45T0TQ TEXT:"minutes"] from the central bank’s September 15-16 Federal Open Market Committee meeting said.
These unnamed central bankers “suggested strengthening the Federal Reserve's strategy, communications, and tools for addressing market dysfunction, should it occur, while limiting the Federal Reserve's footprint in the Treasury market.”
Those comments came from minutes that described central bank deliberations during a period of market unrest. Officials raised rates at last month’s meeting, boosting them by a quarter percentage point to between 3.75% and 4%, as they tightened policy to contend with high levels of inflation. Officials also penciled in another rate increase by year’s end.
The shift in the path of monetary policy has been attended by a sharp rise in government bond yields that breached key levels and generated notable real-world increases in things like [USN:L6N45S1BF TEXT:"mortgage borrowing costs"].
Fed officials have been attributing the rise in yields to a solid economic outlook, the impact of strong tech investment that’s caused government yields to rise to compete for investment, and geopolitical concerns. That said, the power of the move has caused some to worry about the state of the market in a time of huge government deficits and ongoing worries about the outlook for inflation.
These worries brush up against the Fed’s balance sheet because in the last two decades the central bank has addressed big periods of market stress with bond buying. The Fed dealt with the initial phases of the COVID-19 pandemic with big purchases of Treasury and mortgage debt before it transitioned those operations to a form of stimulus, for example.
BALANCE SHEET BALANCING ACT That kind of buying swells the size of the Fed’s balance sheet. But new Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh is opposed to large Fed holdings and would like the balance sheet to be [USN:S8N40E0AX TEXT:"smaller"]. He’s named a task force to consider ways that might make that happen.
The comment in the meeting minutes “sounds like an oblique way to draw a line in the sand and signal to the market and the White House that the Fed's thinking has not changed: It would intervene only if policy transmission is threatened, not simply because yields are rising rapidly,” said Derek Tang, an analyst at Monetary Policy Analytics, Inc.
He added that even if the Fed does step in, it would use tools like its liquidity-providing standing repo operations and the discount window as its first line of defense against an unsettled market. Notably, those two tools are in place and are essentially on autopilot, ready to respond to market needs as they emerge.
Meanwhile, Gennadiy Goldberg, head of US rates strategy at TD Securities, said he sees the comment from the minutes directed at managing technical Treasury bill buying aimed at bolstering reserve levels.
“Given that we tend to see some stresses heading into year-end, this may be the discussion of resuming [Reserve Management Purchases] in the next few months,” he said, adding, “we think the Fed may resume RMP at a modest pace before year-end to ensure everything is functioning smoothly.“
In an interview last week, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari cast doubt on the need for any broad central bank involvement in the bond market in the current situation.
“I see every indication that the Treasury market is functioning fine, so I'm not seeing a financial stability risk, and I don't see any reason why the Fed would intervene, given that the market appears to be functioning just fine,” the official said.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ急落、仏財政懸念で　ドルはＦＯＭＣ議事要旨後も堅調
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　７日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　７日　ロイター］　 - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロが急落した。財政懸念からフランス国債が改めて売り圧力にさらされたことが背景。ドルは直近の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）議事要旨公表後に上げを維持した。

ユーロは０．５３％安の１．１１９８ドルに下落し、５日に付けた１７カ月ぶり安値に迫った。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場では、フランスとイタリアの国債利回りが急上昇した。

マネックスＵＳＡ（ワシントン）のシニアトレーディングディレクター、フアン・ペレス氏は「欧州の問題は、しばらくの間、歳出を膨らませる一方で歳入をあまり増やさない福祉国家型の運営を続けてきたことで、それがついに重荷になってきた点だ。見通しは良くない」と述べた。

主要通貨バスケットに対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．３２％高の１０２．２４。ＦＯＭＣ議事要旨公表を受けて一時上昇幅を縮めたものの、その後持ち直した。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が７日公表した９月１５─１６日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）議事要旨によると、利上げの理由を巡って当局者の見解が分かれていた。

ドルはエネルギー価格が高止まりしていることにも支えられた。ただ原油価格は、不安定な値動きの中で序盤の上昇幅を失った。ペレス氏は「エネルギー資源へのアクセスが困難な局面で米ドルが急伸するという力学は、すでにある程度理解している」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウォッチによると、今月下旬のＦＯＭＣで少なくとも２５ｂｐの利上げが実施される確率は１９．４％と、１週間前の約３８％から低下した。一方、１２月のＦＯＭＣでの利上げ確率は８３％と織り込まれている。

英ポンドは対ドルで０．４２％安の１．３２１６ドル。一方、対ユーロでは２０２５年６月以来の高値を付けた。

対円では、ドルが０．０９％安の１５７．９５円となった。

始値 158.30

高値 158.39

安値 157.91

始値 1.1190

items.title: Christa Pike 'angry and confused' about Tennessee's failed execution effort, lawyers say
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Her lawyers said she has pneumonia, severe swelling and difficulty eating and moving her arms, while Tennessee has suspended executions for the rest of the year.
items.body:

Christa Pike 'angry and confused' about Tennessee's failed execution effort, lawyers say

Her lawyers said she has pneumonia, severe swelling and difficulty eating and moving her arms, while Tennessee has suspended executions for the rest of the year.

A picture taken on December 4, 2007 shows death row inmate Christa Pike entering a Knox County Criminal Court in Knoxville, Tennessee, US, obtained by Reuters on Sep 30, 2026. (File photo: J Miles Cary/ Knoxville News Sentinel/USA Today Network via Reuters)

FAST

WASHINGTON: Christa Pike , sentenced to death for a 1995 murder, awoke "angry and confused" in a hospital this week with a long recuperation ahead after surviving Tennessee's botched effort to execute her, her lawyers said on Wednesday (Oct 7).
A week ago, Pike , 50, was taken from the execution chamber to a Nashville hospital, unconscious, critically ill and with severe arm injuries after two injections of the caustic barbiturate pentobarbital failed to kill her at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution.
As late as Monday, her lawyers believed Pike was brain dead and that life support would be removed the next day following the second botched execution in Tennessee this year, which has renewed scrutiny of capital punishment in the US.
"But on Tuesday, to the shock of everyone, including me, including her team, and including the medical team, Christa woke up and began talking," Randall Spivey, one of her lawyers, told reporters after a court hearing on Wednesday, where a judge ordered Tennessee officials to preserve syringes and other evidence from the botched execution.

"She is angry and confused about everything right now," Spivey said. "She is very aware that the state tried to execute her."
Governor Bill Lee has suspended all executions for the rest of the year while investigators look into the botched executions of Pike and of Tony Carruthers in May, when prison officials were unable to set up intravenous lines.
Pike remains very sick and shackled to her hospital bed, facing a long road to recovery, her lawyers said. She cannot swallow or eat, has pneumonia, cannot move her "tremendously swollen" hands or arms, and it is unclear if she will regain her lost mobility, they said.
Although she still has "cognitive confusion," the lawyers said, she has been speaking with those around her.
"She has wanted to know what's happened, and she's asked about several people," Spivey said. "She's asked about the victim's family."
Pike was sentenced to death for her role as a teenager in the 1995 torture and murder of her 19-year-old schoolmate Colleen Slemmer.
She is the first person known to have survived a "completed execution attempt" in the US, her lawyers say, calling it a violation of the Constitution's prohibition on cruel and unusual punishments.

A UNIQUE CASE Pike 's lawyers are unexpectedly continuing their litigation against state officials, seeking to pierce the secrecy that normally surrounds execution procedures in Tennessee and other states.
Earlier on Wednesday, a judge in Davidson County Chancery Court, I'Ashea Myles, agreed to order Tennessee officials to preserve all evidence from the failed execution, including syringes, drug packaging and lot numbers, catheters, intravenous lines and gurney restraints.
The all-female execution team requested by Pike used at least seven needles during a gruelling ordeal that lasted more than two hours, and one needle was bent 90 degrees when it was pulled out, her lawyers said.
Myles largely sided with Pike 's lawyers at the end of Wednesday's hearing, describing the litigation, which began in January in an effort to prevent the scheduled execution, as unusual because no one had anticipated Pike surviving.
"This case is unique, to say the least," Myles said.
She also ordered the state to preserve internal communications about the attempted execution, including incident reports, witness accounts and encrypted messages.
She has yet to rule on a request by Pike 's lawyers that the Tennessee Department of Correction let them take any residual traces of the execution drugs for chemical analysis.
The Tennessee Department of Correction has opposed what it says is a "duplicative and unnecessary" preservation order, arguing it is already legally required to preserve all evidence and that it was already willing to share most, if not all, of what Pike 's lawyers sought.

Related:

Tennessee prison chief resigns after failed execution

Christa Pike gets 'life-saving medical care' after surviving Tennessee execution

Tennessee and other US states have long struggled to acquire execution drugs. They cannot be obtained from major pharmaceutical companies because of a European trade ban on companies that sell products for use in torture or executions.
Tennessee, like other states, has turned to small, largely unregulated compounding pharmacies to make small batches of the drugs, promising to hide their identity.
"Today's hearing was about transparency, about why Christa , the courts, the media and the public should not simply take the state's word about what happened last Wednesday," Luke Ihnen, another lawyer for Pike , told reporters after the judge's ruling.
He repeated the demand that Tennessee Governor Bill Lee commute Pike 's sentence to life in prison and never attempt to execute her again. A spokesperson for Lee, who denied a clemency appeal two days before the failed execution, did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Pike 's lawyers had sought an alternative to lethal injections, saying her small veins and related medical conditions made her afraid that something would go wrong.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は７日、約３年ぶりの高水準となっている米３０年物住宅ローン金利に関する記者団の質問に対し、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は「米国の低迷」を望んでいると主張した。

トランプ大統領は、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長を「素晴らしい」と評する一方、他の当局者らについては「この国が低迷することを望んでいる」と批判し、「私見では、金利は下がるべきだと考えている」と述べた。

大統領執務室に同席したベセント財務長官は、高インフレの要因に「エネルギーショック」を挙げ、「イラン紛争が収束すれば、エネルギー市場は十分な供給を確保できるようになる」と指摘。そうなれば、米経済は「ＦＲＢの目標に向かって動き始め、住宅ローン金利や１０年債利回りは再び低下するだろう」との認識を示した。

items.summary: [７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は７日、約３年ぶりの高水準となっている米３０年物住宅ローン金利に関する記者団...
items.body:
トランプ氏、ＦＲＢは米の「低迷」望むと主張　住宅ローン金利上昇巡り
4:36 配信

トランプ米大統領（左）とウォーシュＦＲＢ議長。5月22日、ホワイトハウスで撮影。REUTERS/Jonathan Ernst/File Photo

[７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は７日、約３年ぶりの高水準となっている米３０年物住宅ローン金利に関する記者団の質問に対し、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は「米国の低迷」を望んでいると主張した。

トランプ大統領は、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長を「素晴らしい」と評する一方、他の当局者らについては「この国が低迷することを望んでいる」と批判し、「私見では、金利は下がるべきだと考えている」と述べた。

大統領執務室に同席したベセント財務長官は、高インフレの要因に「エネルギーショック」を挙げ、「イラン紛争が収束すれば、エネルギー市場は十分な供給を確保できるようになる」と指摘。そうなれば、米経済は「ＦＲＢの目標に向かって動き始め、住宅ローン金利や１０年債利回りは再び低下するだろう」との認識を示した。

items.title: Conditions are diverging across Canada’s largest housing markets, report finds
items.author: Jordan Fleguel
items.summary: In the middle of the fall buying season, Canada’s housing market is in a precarious position, with conditions varying greatly from region to region, each facing its own unique economic challenges.
items.body: In the middle of the fall buying season, Canada’s housing market is in a precarious position, with conditions varying greatly from region to region, each facing its own unique economic challenges. That’s according to a report released on Tuesday by RBC Economics. It found that renewed pressure is being felt in markets across the country as trade tensions between Canada and the U.S. ramped back up last month, but some places appear to be handling it better than others. “Diverging trends across the country reflect different states of confidence, affordability, pent-up demand, demographics, job markets and market inventory,” Robert Hogue, RBC Economics’ assistant chief economist and report author, wrote. “Even macroeconomic factors like interest rates and immigration policy see their impact shaped by the local context.” In September, most local real estate boards reported drops in home resales, the report noted, including in the Ontario markets of Hamilton, Kitchener-Waterloo, Toronto and Ottawa, as well as in Vancouver and Montreal. “Many have also shown easing home values — a continuing trend in Vancouver and the Fraser Valley where prices have steadily fallen since early 2025,” wrote Hogue. Other areas saw price stabilization in September, the report noted, including Edmonton due to “faster rates of depreciation earlier.” Toronto stumbles as Montreal ups supply “It didn’t take long for the tentative recovery to go off course in the Toronto area,” Hogue wrote, referring to a gentle market rally in Canada’s largest city that began in the spring and lasted though August. “September confirmed the new direction with resales and the benchmark price losing another step down 5.2 per cent and 0.5 per cent month-over month, respectively,” he said. Hogue said that for the roughly five-month recovery period to have continued, consumer confidence would have needed to keep improving, but recent escalations in the U.S.-Canada trade war and long-term interest rate concerns “put buyers on the defensive.” Meanwhile, in Montreal, growing inventory has limited home price growth, according to Hogue. “Inventory is now up 20 per cent from a year ago, propelled by the strongest influx of sellers in six years amid calmer resales,” he wrote. “The process of rebalancing supply and demand continues to dampen home value appreciation.” Vancouver slumps, Calgary holds steady On Canada’s West Coast, home prices in Vancouver remain “squarely in correction mode,” Hogue said, arguing there were no indications in September that the market’s prolonged slump will end any time soon. Despite price declines, buyers still haven’t come off the sidelines in meaningful numbers as affordability concerns persist. “Further depreciation will likely be necessary to draw in more buyers,” wrote Hogue. “And with inventory remaining abundant — active listings are still near a decade high — and seller competition fierce, we think this is in the cards for the rest of this year and possibly into 2027.” In Alberta’s largest market, it was a different story in September, Hogue said. “Calgary’s state has changed little this year. Home resales remained generally stable and historically robust despite hovering below a year ago,” he wrote. “Inventory largely stayed on last year’s track, keeping supply and demand balanced. Prices have also stabilized close to 2025.” However, conditions differed greatly depending on housing type. Single-detached homes saw a 4.4 per cent increase in resales and a 1 per cent price drop compared to 2025, Hogue said. “This contrasted with material declines of 14.3 per cent and 8.3 per cent, respectively, for condo apartments,” he wrote. At the national level, Hogue said RBC Economics expects some pent-up housing demand to be unlocked in the months ahead, as long as affordability improves and Canada’s economy continues to weather the U.S. trade-war storm. “But,” he said, “the road ahead is likely to be bumpy and uneven across markets.”

WASHINGTON, Oct 7 : US President Donald Trump will speak at a White House event on scientific discovery on Thursday, according to a social media post from his tech adviser Michael Kratsios.
The event will highlight the Trump administration's plan to overhaul how federal scientific research funding is managed and distributed, according to an invitation seen by Reuters. Kratsios first released the plan in July. Energy Secretary Chris Wright and NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman will also speak at the event, according to the invitation and a post from Kratsios on the social media platform X. 
Trump will separately award the National Medal of Science on Thursday to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Google co-founder Sergey Brin, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and AMD CEO Lisa Su, a White House official said in a statement. The National Medal of Science is the nation's highest honor for scientists and engineers, according to the US National Science Foundation's website.
Dell Technologies CEO Michael Dell and Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella will receive the National Medal of Technology and Innovation, the White House official said. That is the nation’s highest honor for technological achievement, according to the US Patent and Trademark Office's website. 

Source: Reuters

items.title: CDC considera baixo o risco de peste e monitora chegadas da Sibéria, diz diretora
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A diretora do Centro de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças (CDC) dos Estados Unidos, Erica Schwartz, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que o risco decorrente de um caso não confirmado de peste pneumônica na Sibéria é extremamente baixo para os EUA, mas a agência está preparada para monitorar e fazer uma triagem dos viajantes.
items.body:
A diretora do Centro de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças (CDC) dos Estados Unidos, Erica Schwartz, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que o risco decorrente de um caso não confirmado de peste pneumônica na Sibéria é extremamente baixo para os EUA, mas a agência está preparada para monitorar e fazer uma triagem dos viajantes.
“Estamos trabalhando com o Departamento de Segurança Interna, com o Departamento de Estado, o Departamento de Guerra e outras agências do governo para garantir que saibamos exatamente se alguém daquela região entrar nos Estados Unidos”, disse Schwartz no evento “O Futuro da Saúde”, organizado pelo Wall Street Journal em Washington.
O CDC possui um posto de saúde no Aeroporto Internacional John F. Kennedy que pode realizar vigilância e triagem de viajantes da região que entram nos Estados Unidos, acrescentou.
O Departamento de Saúde e Serviços Humanos (HHS, na sigla em inglês) dos EUA não respondeu imediatamente se a agência planeja estabelecer triagem no JFK.
Um porta-voz do HHS disse que cerca de 200 pessoas por ano procedentes da região da Sibéria viajam para os Estados Unidos. Os voos diretos entre a Rússia e os Estados Unidos estão suspensos desde o início da guerra na Ucrânia, em 2022.
O órgão regulador de saúde da Rússia afirmou que não há riscos de uma epidemia na Sibéria após a morte de uma funcionária do instituto de peste local por pneumonia de origem ainda não determinada, em um caso que gerou preocupação internacional.
“O que estamos fazendo, de uma perspectiva governamental ampla, é garantir que entendamos exatamente qual é essa ameaça”, disse Schwartz.
“Estamos muito confiantes de que a ameaça para os Estados Unidos é extremamente baixa.”
O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, também disse a jornalistas não acreditar que a morte tenha sido causada por uma arma biológica.

items.title: 米台関係、米中首脳会談後も強固　防衛装備の適時引き渡し重要＝駐米代表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Brunnstrom

[ワシントン　７日　ロイター] -
items.body:
David Brunnstrom

[ワシントン　７日　ロイター] - 台北駐米経済文化代表処のアレクサンダー・ユー代表（駐米大使に相当）は７日、先月の米中首脳会談後も米台関係は引き続き強固との認識を示し、米国による防衛装備品の適時の引き渡しが重要になると強調した。

トランプ米大統領は９月２４日に中国の習近平国家主席をホワイトハウスに迎え、国賓待遇で首脳会談を実施。トランプ氏は習氏との良好な関係を優先し、台湾に対する総額１４０億ドル規模の新たな武器売却計画の承認を見送っている。

ユー代表はワシントンで開かれたシンポジウムで、米政府は対台湾政策に変更はないと明確に示しているとし、「米台関係は依然として強固だと自信を持って言える」と述べた。

その上で、平和を維持する最も効果的な方法は力による抑止だとし、「侵略が容易でも低コストでもないとの認識を確実にすること」が重要になると指摘。「抑止力に信頼性を持たせるためには、台湾自身の投資に加え、装備品の適時引き渡しや効果的な訓練、それらの投資を実際の抑止力へと結び付ける能力が必要になる」と語った。

最新鋭のＦ１６戦闘機の最初の２機がこのほど台湾に引き渡されたことについて、台湾の自衛能力強化に向けた米国との協力が着実に進展している好例だと指摘。「今後も米台協力はこうした取り組みの中核であり続ける」と述べた。

ロイターは今月、中国の習主席は必要に応じて２０２７年までに台湾を武力で掌握できる態勢を整えるよう軍に指示しているものの、米政府当局者の間では２８年以前の中国による台湾侵攻の可能性は低下しているとの見方が強まっていると報道。

これに関連してユー氏は「２７年、もしくは２８年以降など、さまざまな見方が出ているが、われわれの責任は変わらない。台湾をより強く、より強靱にし、敵対勢力による威圧を受けにくくすることだ」とし、台湾の防衛態勢はある特定の時期を前提に構築されているわけではないと語った。

現在、台湾の林佳龍外交部長（外相）と蔡英文前総統が米国を訪問中。林氏は同シンポジウムで行ったビデオ演説で、台湾と米国は半導体、人工知能（ＡＩ）、サプライチェーン（供給網）安全保障などの分野で協力を深めており、「真の共生関係」にあるパートナーになったと指摘。台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）が米アリゾナ州で進める投資に言及し、こうした投資は経済的な結び付きが共通の利益と長期的な信頼関係の醸成につながっていると述べた。

items.title: US will rescind policy targeting oil and gas industry methane leaks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Environmental Protection Agency said on Wednesday it would soon propose scrapping a Biden-era rule aimed at curbing large leaks of methane from oil and gas operations.
items.body:
The US Environmental Protection Agency said on Wednesday it would soon propose scrapping a [USN:L1N3CW2NF TEXT:"Biden-era rule"] aimed at curbing large leaks of methane from oil and gas operations.
The move is part of a broad Trump administration effort to slash regulations that it says burden US businesses as it seeks to boost fossil fuel production.
"Americans must be able to afford to heat their homes in the winter and fill up their car and drive to work. They can’t do that when the people producing the energy are weighed down by unnecessary burdens," EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said in a statement after making the announcement at a meeting with oil and gas industry representatives in New Mexico.
EPA's "super emitter" program requires companies to react when third parties report suspected methane leaks using remote sensing. The Trump administration, after taking office last year, had delayed implementation of the policy until next year.
EPA said its proposal to rescind the rule would save $45 billion a year.
[USN:L1N2RT11T TEXT:"Methane"] is the second-biggest cause of climate change after carbon dioxide, and the oil and gas industry is a major source of the gas.
Environmental groups criticized the move.
"This giveaway to fossil fuel executives is foolish and short-sighted, and reveals who the Trump administration really works for - its political donors,” Mahyar Sorour, director of the Sierra Club's Beyond Fossil Fuels campaign, said in a statement.

items.title: Spanish woman whose eviction ignited housing protests dies at 87
items.author: Pietro Lombardi, Corina Pons
items.creator: Pietro Lombardi, Corina Pons
items.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, the 87-year-old Spanish woman whose dramatic eviction last month sparked mass housing protests that led to an early election, has died, the Madrid tenants' union said on Wednesday, as thousands demonstrated over her death.
items.body:
Maricarmen Abascal, the 87-year-old Spanish woman whose [USN:L8N45F0PQ TEXT:"dramatic eviction"] last month sparked mass housing protests that led to an early election, has died, the Madrid tenants' union said on Wednesday, as thousands demonstrated over her death.
Abascal had been in hospital for severe anxiety and exhaustion since her eviction on September 23 from her home of more than 70 years, when police and social workers removed her by stretcher.
Her case ignited protests over a mounting housing crisis including a shortage of homes and surging rents. Activists camped out in a major Madrid square.
Following news of Abascal's death on Wednesday, thousands marched from the square, Puerta del Sol, towards parliament, chanting: "This is not a death. It's a murder!" A cause of death was not announced.
"This was a completely avoidable death that symbolizes the drama that is the housing crisis in Spain," said 36-year-old marcher Dario Gomez in Madrid.
Demonstrators also held protests in Barcelona.
Trade unions on Wednesday [USN:L1N45T0BN TEXT:"announced"] a nationwide general strike over housing issues on November 11.
The protests, along with [USN:L1N45O0BD TEXT:"parliament's rejection last week"] of decrees aimed at curbing evictions and limiting rent pressures, prompted Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez to call an [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"early election"] for November 29.
Sanchez is seeking to shift the political narrative from his government's [USN:L1N4510WI TEXT:"handling of a migrant crisis"] in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta and a [USN:L1N42U0KB TEXT:"series of corruption cases"] involving his Socialist Party and his family to the housing crisis, hoping to tap into growing resentment over rising rents.
"Now, following her passing, we are left with the example of the fight she waged and the legacy Maricarmen has left behind. And, above all, we will honour what she always asked of us: 'Fight, keep fighting for what is yours,'" the tenants' union said in a statement.
Sanchez lamented Abascal's death in an X post. "A hug as well to all of us who feel this loss as our own today," he wrote.
The leader of Spain’s centre-right opposition People’s Party, Alberto Nunez Feijoo, said on X that Abascal's death shouldn't be politicised. There should be "no campaigns, no political parties, no other interests here," he wrote. "In the face of someone’s death, respect is all that matters.”
HOUSE BOUGHT BY INVESTMENT FUND Abascal was evicted after an investment fund bought her house. Several days later, her lawyer said she reached an eight-year agreement with her landlord that would allow her [USN:L1N45J05P TEXT:"to return home"] and pay rent at the same prior amount.
She had planned to sign the deal once she felt better, but never had the opportunity to leave hospital.
A neighbour of Abascal, whose home was near Madrid's famed Retiro Park, said she was shaped by living through Spain's authoritarian Franco regime, which ended in 1975.
"She was a fighter, with very clear ideas, a somewhat broad sense of justice, and, above all, perhaps a social conscience and ideas about solidarity," he said.
Guillermo Ruiz, 31, an audiovisual specialist at the mass march, said he felt pessimistic about change. "The best homage we can pay to her is to continue the fight, continue to mobilise, fight for a dignified life and that what happened to her doesn't happen to anyone else."

items.title: Anglo-Teck merger, nickel sale are test cases for navigating geopolitical complexities, CEO says
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: Anglo American’s proposed US$54 billion merger with Canada’s Teck Resources and the sale of its Brazilian nickel business have become test cases for navigating geopolitical complexities as they await ...
items.body: JOHANNESBURG -- Anglo American’s proposed US$54 billion merger with Canada’s Teck Resources and the sale of its Brazilian nickel business have become test cases for navigating geopolitical complexities as they await antitrust approval, CEO Duncan Wanblad said on Wednesday. The Anglo-Teck merger, announced in 2025, has received approval from all countries where the companies operate except China. Both expect the deal to close by March 2027. Critical minerals have become a flashpoint in global competition, with major economies seeking to secure supply chains for electric vehicles, renewable energy and defence. China’s antitrust regulator has asked Anglo American to commit to supplying the country with a steady flow of copper concentrate as a condition for approving the merger, three people aware of the development said. Geopolitical shifts, supply chain disruptions and critical mineral nationalism have created a complex environment for such deals, Wanblad told a mining conference in Johannesburg via video link. ‘In new waters’ “We are in new waters. We are pioneering in a way. I genuinely don’t think from an antitrust perspective there should be any issues with any of these deals,” Wanblad said. He cited Anglo’s proposed sale of its Brazilian nickel business to MMG, which drew a warning from the European Union over concerns the Hong Kong-listed miner could divert supply away from Europe, hurting stainless steel producers there. The sale is awaiting EU approval. Anglo American also agreed to sell its steelmaking coal mines in Australia to U.K.-based miner Dhilmar for up to $3.88 billion. “We are kind of the guinea pigs for the market in terms of working this out,” Wanblad said. Wanblad also said he was hopeful the sale of diamond company De Beers would be completed by the end of this year. The sale of the assets is part of Anglo’s restructuring aimed at focusing on copper and iron ore. The Teck merger would expand Anglo’s copper portfolio, positioning it as the fifth-largest producer of the metal critical to the energy transition. (Reporting by Nelson Banya and Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo; Editing by Rod Nickel)

items.title: イエメン戦闘激化、フーシ派がサウジ2空港攻撃　3人死亡
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [７日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[７日　ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派とサウジアラビアが支援するイエメン暫定政府軍との戦闘が激化している。イエメン運輸省は、フーシ派が７日未明、南部の港湾都市アデンの国際空港を弾道ミサイルと爆発物搭載ドローン（無人機）で攻撃したと発表した。 

一方、サウジアラビア民間航空当局は７日、国内の２空港が攻撃を受け、３人が死亡し、３６人が負傷したと明らかにした。

当局の声明によると、攻撃は６日と７日に発生。首都リヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港では１人が死亡、８人が負傷、アブハ国際空港では２人が死亡、２８人が負傷した。どちらの空港がどちらの日に攻撃を受けたかは明らかにしていない。

米国とイランの紛争が波及した今回の戦闘は、世界最悪の人道危機の一つにつながったイエメンでの１２年間にわたる内戦を再燃させた。国連の国際移住機関（ＩＯＭ）のデータによると、フーシ派とイエメン暫定政府軍との戦闘を受け、イエメン国内では７日時点で２０万人以上が避難を余儀なくされたことが分かった。

items.summary: ＜ロンドン株式市場＞　反落して取引を終えた。銀行株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は４営業日ぶりに反落。債券利回りの急上昇が相場の重荷となった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は反落し、０．７４％安。    英３０年債利回りは約２８年ぶりの高水準を付けた。英ポンドは対ユーロで約１年４カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。     ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は３．９０％安。スタンダード・チャータードは４．５％、バークレイズは３．４％それぞれ下落した。ＨＳＢＣは４．４％安。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズは、ＨＳＢＣが人工知能（ＡＩ）導入推進の一環として英国のウェルス・マネジメント事業で大規模な人員削減を計画していると報じた。    石油大手のシェルは、７─９月期の精製マージンが４─６月期を大幅に上回る見通しを示したものの、０．１％安だった。
items.body:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞　反落して取引を終えた。銀行株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は４営業日ぶりに反落。債券利回りの急上昇が相場の重荷となった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は反落し、０．７４％安。    英３０年債利回りは約２８年ぶりの高水準を付けた。英ポンドは対ユーロで約１年４カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。     ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は３．９０％安。スタンダード・チャータードは４．５％、バークレイズは３．４％それぞれ下落した。ＨＳＢＣは４．４％安。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズは、ＨＳＢＣが人工知能（ＡＩ）導入推進の一環として英国のウェルス・マネジメント事業で大規模な人員削減を計画していると報じた。    石油大手のシェルは、７─９月期の精製マージンが４─６月期を大幅に上回る見通しを示したものの、０．１％安だった。    上下水道・廃棄物処理のペノン・グループは２０．１％安。新株発行による増資と配当減を発表し、売りが膨らんだ。 

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞　４営業日ぶりに反落して取引を終えた。長期金利の上昇を受け、投資家にリスク回避の姿勢が強まった。ドイツの１０年債利回りは一時３．５２７９％まで上昇。フランスの財政を巡る懸念も続いている。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種銀行株指数は３．３１％、テクノロジー株指数は１．８９％それぞれ下落。ＵＢＳが投資判断を引き下げたオランダの半導体組立装置メーカー、ＢＥセミコンダクターは８．５％安だった。    自動車・部品株指数は０．３３％安。欧州連合（ＥＵ）が中国製ハイブリッド車（ＨＶ）の域内への輸入制限を検討していると伝わり、買い優勢となる場面もあった。    上下水道・廃棄物処理のペノン・グループは２０．１％安。新株発行による増資と配当減を発表し、売りが膨らんだ。 

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　フランスとイタリアの国債利回りが急上昇した。エネルギー価格の上昇を背景に世界的な債券売り圧力が高まる中、一部のユーロ圏諸国の高水準の債務に対する懸念が意識された。    フランス１０年債利回りは１２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．８７％。取引時間中に１８ｂｐ上昇する場面もあった。フランス国債は、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比５％を超える広範な財政赤字と、来年実施される大統領選挙を巡り投資家が懸念を強める中、欧州における債券売りの中心となっている。    独仏１０年債利回り格差は１３６ｂｐと６ｂｐ拡大。同利回り格差は先週、２０１２年以来の高水準となる約１６０ｂｐを付けていた。    イタリア１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ上昇の４．６４６％と、２３年１０月以来の高水準に迫った。    安全資産を求める動きが見られる中、ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは３．４８４％と横ばいで推移。    一方、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りはＥＣＢの利上げ観測が後退する中、４ｂｐ低下の３．０４２％となった。

Trump administration plans to charge international students $70,000 for work authorization

By Susan Heavey
WASHINGTON, Oct 6 (Reuters) – The US Department of Homeland Security has proposed that international students pay at least $70,000 in training fees if they want to work in the country, according to a government notice posted online on Wednesday, part of the Trump administration’s wider crackdown on foreign visa holders. 

Under the proposal, nonimmigrant students with F-1 visas would be required to pay $70,000 to a certified institution for on-the-job training, known as Optional Practical Training (OPT), and $30,000 for any additional work training. 

DHS said the new rules were meant “to combat fraud, strengthen the integrity of the immigration system, and protect US workers.”

Show Full Article

Under the OPT system, foreign students can engage in work training for up to 20 hours per week while school is in session, as well as for a limited time after graduation, with an additional allowance for those with degrees in science, technology, engineering and mathematics. Those who enroll are currently expected to pay around $500.

“DHS is now setting a fee to ensure employers, students, and institutions are engaging in appropriate activities consistent with admission as an F-1 nonimmigrant,” the agency said.

Such training programs often serve as a bridge for students seeking work under H-1B visas, which the Trump administration has also targeted with increased fees.

For decades, the H-1B program has allowed young engineers and scientists from across the world, especially India and China, to turn years of study at US universities into high-paying jobs and a path to permanent US residency. Leading US tech companies have come to rely heavily on these workers to fill skilled positions.

When he was campaigning in 2024, President Donald Trump vowed he would make it easier for foreign students to remain in the country, suggesting they be automatically awarded a Green Card after graduation. 

Like similar DHS proposals, the rule change is likely to be met with swift legal challenges. 

“This proposed rule isn’t going to fare well in the courts, just as the 100k H-1B fee and other restrictionist policies have been struck down,” Doug Rand, director of the Talent Mobility Fund, which works to attract foreign STEM professionals, wrote on LinkedIn on Wednesday. 

The proposal is subject to 30 days of public comment before it can be finalized. 

DHS said it would wait 60 days after finalization before putting the rule into effect to allow schools, students and employers time to prepare. 

(Reporting by Susan Heavey; Editing by Daniel Wallis)

items.title: ＦＲＢ9月利上げ理由で見解相違、債券市場混乱への備え要請も＝議事要旨
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -  米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が７日公表した９月１５─１６日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）議事要旨によると、利上げの理由を巡って当局者の見解が分かれていた。一部の参加者はエネルギーなどの価格ショックの影響を抑えるために必要と判断した一方、よりタカ派的な参加者は、需要主導のインフレが生じつつあることへの備えとして必要と捉えていた。また、一部の当局者からは、債券市場の混乱に備え中央銀行として対応策を準備すべきだとの意見も示された。 

ＦＲＢは９月会合で、フェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を０．２５％ポイント引き上げ、３．７５─４．００％とすると決定した。決定は全会一致だった。

ただ、その措置が主に予防的なものなのか、投資や支出を抑えるために金融政策を大幅に引き締める方向への転換なのかを巡っては、当局者の見解が一致しなかった。

議事要旨は「多くの参加者は、リスク管理の観点から政策金利の誘導目標レンジをより高めに推移させることが賢明だと強調した。これは、需要が予想以上に強まったり、供給面で新たな悪影響を伴うショックが起きたりすることで、インフレ率が目標を上回ったまま高止まりする事態への備えとなる」と記した。

一方、別の参加者は、９月に決定した政策金利の引き上げについて、最近のエネルギーなどの価格ショックが物価により広範な影響を及ぼすのを防ぐ上で重要と判断した。２人の参加者は、中立金利の推計値が従来より高いと考えており、それに合わせる措置として利上げを支持した。

また「複数の参加者は、現在の政策金利が景気抑制的ではないか、抑制的であってもその程度は小さいとの見方を示した」という。さらに、「大半の参加者は、年末までにＦＦ金利の誘導目標レンジを再び引き上げることが適切になる可能性が高いと判断した」とした。

＜バランスシート政策、市場ストレスに備える必要性＞

バランスシート政策についても議論が交わされた。議事要旨は「バランスシート政策に関して、少数の参加者は米国債市場が円滑に機能していると指摘しつつも、市場ストレスへの備えの重要性に言及した」としている。

これらの当局者は、ＦＲＢが米国債市場で占める存在感を抑えつつ、「市場機能不全が起きた場合に対処するためのＦＲＢの戦略、コミュニケーション、ツールを強化すること」を提案した。

金融政策の方向性の転換は、国債利回りの急上昇を伴い、住宅ローン金利などに顕著な上昇をもたらした。

ＦＲＢ当局者はこの利回り上昇について、堅調な景気見通しやハイテク投資の影響、そして地政学的懸念を要因として挙げてきた。ただ、相場変動の勢いの強さから、巨額の財政赤字とインフレ見通しへの継続的な懸念が存在する中での市場の状態について不安を抱く当局者も出てきている。

こうした懸念はＦＲＢのバランスシートに関わるものだ。過去２０年間、ＦＲＢは市場ストレスの大きな局面で債券買い入れを通じて対応してきた。例えば、新型コロナウイルス感染症の流行初期には国債と住宅ローン担保証券（ＭＢＳ）の大量購入を行い、その後、こうした操作を景気刺激策の形に移行させた。

＜バランスシートを巡る綱渡り＞

そうした買い入れはＦＲＢのバランスシートの規模を膨らませる。ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長はバランスシート縮小を望んでおり、それを検証するためのタスクフォース（作業部会）を任命している。

マネタリーポリシー・アナリティクスのアナリスト、デレク・タン氏は、議事要旨のコメントについて「ＦＲＢの考え方が変わっていないことを市場とホワイトハウスに暗に示す、遠回しな表現のようだ。すなわち、政策波及が脅かされる場合にのみ介入するのであり、単に利回りが急上昇しているからというだけでは介入しない」との見方を示した。

タン氏はさらに、たとえＦＲＢが介入するとしても、動揺する市場に対する第一防衛線として、流動性を供給する常設レポ・オペレーションやディスカウント・ウィンドウ（連銀窓口貸出）といったツールを用いるだろうと述べた。注目すべきは、これら２つのツールが既に整備されており、市場のニーズが発生した際に対応できるよう、本質的に自動運転状態にあることだ。

一方、ＴＤセキュリティーズの米金利戦略責任者ゲナディ・ゴールドバーグ氏は、議事要旨のコメントは、準備預金水準を下支えするための米短期国債買い入れの技術的な管理に向けられたものと見ている。

同氏は「年末にかけて若干のストレスが見られる傾向にあることを踏まえると、これは今後数カ月の間に準備金管理買い入れ（ＲＭＰ）を再開することに関する議論なのかもしれない」と述べ、「ＦＲＢはすべてが円滑に機能することを確実にするため、年末までに控えめなペースでＲＭＰを再開する可能性があると考えている」と付け加えた。

items.title: Foreign investors pull out $26.3 billion from emerging markets in September as hawkish Fed pushes US Treasury yields higher
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Foreign investors pulled $26.3 billion from emerging-market stocks and bonds in September due to rising US yields. The hawkish Federal Reserve's interest rate hike influenced this first outflow since June. Additionally, heavy foreign selling in South Korea resulted in a significant decrease in emerging-market equities. While fixed-income assets attracted $246 billion this year, equities saw year-to-date outflows of $113.9 billion.
items.body: Foreign investors withdrew $26.3 billion from emerging-market stocks and bonds in September, marking the first monthly outflow since June, as a hawkish Federal Reserve pushed US yields and the dollar higher, the Institute of International Finance said on Wednesday, Reuters reported.Non-resident investors pulled $7 billion from emerging-market fixed-income assets during the month, resulting in the first net outflow since March, when an escalating conflict in the Middle East unsettled global markets.Emerging markets came under pressure after the Fed, led by Kevin Warsh, raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 and signalled that inflation remained a concern.The Federal Open Market Committee's decision sent US Treasury yields sharply higher, strengthened the dollar and prompted investors to retreat from riskier assets.“The pressure built in the second half of the month, as hard currency bond funds turned to outflows in the week of the FOMC decision and EM dollar credit spreads widened,” the report said, according to Reuters.“Looking ahead, a hawkish Warsh Fed that projects further hikes, a BoJ (Bank of Japan) at its highest policy rate since 1995 and broad tightening across advanced economies all raise the hurdle for EM carry into the fourth quarter,” it added.Heavy foreign selling in South Korea drove a $19.2 billion outflow from emerging-market equities in September, according to the IIF.“Foreign selling of Korean equities has run through most of the year, and its September peak came after a 62% rise in the KOSPI this year,” the institute said.The retreat also coincided with cooling enthusiasm around the artificial-intelligence-driven technology rally that had lifted several Asian markets this year. Investors locked in gains from richly valued semiconductor and technology stocks.All regions recorded fixed-income outflows in September, although the asset class has still attracted $246 billion from foreign portfolio investors so far this year.The picture was weaker for equities, where year-to-date outflows reached $113.9 billion, compared with $27.3 billion during the same period last year. Excluding China, equity outflows totalled $151.5 billion.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

NEW YORK, Oct 7 : Elliott Investment Management and Siris are exploring a sale of Gigamon that could value the infrastructure software provider at more than $2 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
The firms have tapped investment bankers at Bank of America and Perella Weinberg Partners to advise Gigamon on the process, which is in its early stages, said the people, who requested anonymity because the deliberations are confidential.
A sale process could attract interest from private equity firms as well as strategic buyers seeking to expand their capabilities in network monitoring, cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure management, the people said.
Based in Santa Clara, California, Gigamon provides software that helps companies monitor network traffic and detect security threats. Founded in 2004, the company serves more than 4,000 customers globally, including banks, healthcare providers and government agencies, according to its website.

Gigamon generated more than $400 million in annual recurring revenue and around $170 million in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA), the sources said. 
Gigamon, Siris, Elliott, and Bank of America declined to comment. Perella Weinberg did not respond to a request for comment.
Elliott acquired Gigamon in 2017 in a take-private transaction, which valued the company at about $1.6 billion. Private equity firm Siris bought a minority stake in Gigamon in 2024.
The potential sale comes as investors continue to show interest in software companies that provide critical infrastructure tools underpinning cloud computing, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence deployments.

FAST

Oct 7 : The world's oldest-known terrestrial animal, an Aldabra giant tortoise named Jonathan and estimated to be about 194 years old, may owe his extraordinary longevity to a combination of genetic traits and an ability to keep key cellular systems functioning in a more youthful way, according to scientists. 
Members of this species are known to live more than 100 years, but Jonathan has far exceeded that. Brought to the remote South Atlantic island of St Helena as a fully grown animal in 1882, likely from the Aldabra Atoll or the Granitic Seychelles, the tortoise now resides in a paddock at Plantation House, the governor's residence. 
"Other Aldabra tortoises have been claimed to have lived as long as Jonathan, but he has the most documentary evidence supporting his age," said Benjamin Vaisvil, a researcher affiliated with the organization Kallel and co-lead author of the study published on Wednesday in the journal Science Advances.
Scientists have studied Jonathan to explore the secrets of the animal's amazing longevity, sequencing his genome and analysing his epigenome — the chemical markers that control which genes switch on and off.

"We found changes in Jonathan's genome in pathways associated with longevity, like DNA repair, mitochondrial function, insulin regulation and telomere function," Vaisvil said. 
Mitochondria are structures considered the powerhouse of a cell. Insulin is a hormone that helps regulate levels of blood sugar by letting it enter the body's cells for energy. Telomeres are protective caps at the ends of chromosomes, structures that carry genetic information inside cell nuclei. 
Researchers compared Jonathan's epigenome with four other Aldabra tortoises, ranging from juveniles to older adults. While pretending to feed Jonathan, they waited until he began biting the air, then wedged his mouth open with a gloved hand and scraped under his tongue with a specialized kit. St Helena officials restrict blood draws to prevent infection risks.
To explain the finding, Vaisvil compared the genome to a cookbook and the epigenome to handwritten notes in the margins.
"As the cookbook ages, those notes become more difficult to read clearly. We can think of that as methylation entropy," Vaisvil said, referring to a metric for disorder in a certain biochemical process.
Most of the notes in Jonathan's "cookbook" look very old. But in certain regions, stretches of DNA that act as switches controlling whether genes are turned on or off, Jonathan's methylation entropy was lower than that of every tortoise studied except a 5-year-old juvenile. These regions controlled genes that influence longevity. 
The researchers identified 287 genes with variants unique to Jonathan, including some linked to tumour suppression and DNA repair. The tortoise also carries extra copies of a gene that encodes a protein that hunts down ageing and cancerous cells.
'GENTLE GIANT'
When younger, Jonathan was known for mischievous antics including overturning chairs and lying on croquet balls, according to the tortoise's longtime veterinarian and study co-author Joe Hollins. Cataracts have since left him mostly blind. Hollins describes Jonathan today as "a gentle giant."
Determining how long giant tortoises can live is challenging because reliable historical records are scarce and many outlive researchers. Record-keeping before the 20th century also was problematic. While a young tortoise's age can be estimated from growth rings on the plates that form the animal's shell, ascertaining the age of adults is more difficult. 
The new study involved only one exceptionally old tortoise, making it hard to determine whether the traits identified are unique to Jonathan or common among long-lived tortoises. 
"We cannot say for certain that what we found is the reason for his longevity," Vaisvil said.
Environmental factors also may have contributed. Jonathan lives on a tropical island, with an optimal diet carefully managed by trained veterinarians.
The research findings broadly match patterns documented in studies of exceptionally long-lived people, suggesting that some mechanisms of aging may be shared across species. 
Vaisvil noted that a recent study of a 117-year-old woman found unusually efficient mitochondrial function, echoing findings in some of Jonathan's regions.
VORACIOUS APPETITE
Despite his age, Jonathan retains a voracious appetite, Hollins said, lifting his head and stretching out his long neck when the veterinarian calls out his name. 
"I know he knows me, knows my voice and my handling, and I also know it isn't love on his part but a recognition of the arrival of a feast," Hollins said. "And yet I, of course, don't mind. I have a huge affection for him." 
"He is a remarkable symbol. Icon, I know, is an overused word, but Guinness World Records has just given him 'icon' status this year," Hollins said. 
Beloved by island residents, Jonathan has lived through world wars and the rise and fall of empires. 
"He is symbolic of resilience, longevity, endurance, a persistent presence throughout huge historic events," Hollins said.

Source: Reuters

Oct 7 : Anthropic on Wednesday launched Claude Haiku 5.5, the third model in its Claude 5.5 family in the past month, expanding its artificial intelligence lineup ahead of a planned IPO.
Here are some details:
• Haiku 5.5 is built for tasks such as classification, summarization and extraction, including live support, voice agents and in-app assistants. It costs 75 per cent less than its predecessor, Haiku 4.5.
• The new model is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens for prompts under 100,000 tokens, rising to $0.50 and $2.50, respectively, for longer prompts.
• The company said it is Anthropic's first Haiku with built-in safeguards for a narrow set of high-risk cybersecurity requests, and added that most everyday tasks would not be impacted.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Fed policymakers divided over rate-hike logic in September, minutes show
items.author: Howard Schneider
items.creator: Howard Schneider
items.summary: Federal Reserve policymakers were divided last month over the rationale for raising interest rates, with "some participants" seeing a hike as needed to keep the impact of energy and other price shocks at bay, but a more hawkish core viewing it as necessary to guard against emerging demand-driven inflation.
items.body:
Federal Reserve policymakers were divided last month over the rationale for raising interest rates, with "some participants" seeing a hike as needed to keep the impact of energy and other price shocks at bay, but a more hawkish core viewing it as necessary to guard against emerging demand-driven inflation.
The competing arguments were outlined in the minutes of the US central bank's September 15-16 meeting, at which the Fed voted unanimously to raise the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"policy rate"] by a quarter of a percentage point even as officials disagreed about whether the move was largely precautionary or represented a shift towards significantly tighter monetary policy meant to curb investment and spending.
The split, and the varying interpretations of where the economy stands right now, set up a likely vigorous debate at the October 27-28 policy meeting over whether inflation has taken on a broader, demand-driven dimension that warrants further Fed action now. The alternative would be to wait on further rate hikes to see if incoming data shows energy, tariff and other price shocks receding and inflation heading back to the central bank's 2% target.
"Many participants emphasized that a higher path for the target range would be prudent on risk-management grounds, providing insurance against inflation remaining persistently above target due to stronger-than-expected demand or further adverse supply shocks," said the minutes of the session, which were released on Wednesday.
Others, meanwhile, saw the "higher policy rate" approved in September as important to prevent recent energy and other shocks from having a broader influence on prices, while "a couple" framed their support for the hike as matching what they saw as a higher estimated neutral rate of interest.
"Several participants stated that they viewed the current policy rate as not restrictive or only mildly restrictive," the minutes stated. "Most participants assessed that another increase in the target range for the federal funds rate would likely be appropriate by year end."
Investors, who had expected sequential rate hikes in the days following the September meeting, have since pared back their bets and now see the Fed keeping its policy rate in the 3.75%-4.00% range at its meeting later this month, just ahead of midterm congressional elections, but hiking again at the December 8-9 gathering.
Following the release of [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"weaker-than-expected jobs"] and [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"inflation data"], Fed officials' recent comments added weight to the sense that policymakers would now allow some time for new data to show whether underlying inflation was coming down from current levels that are more than a percentage point above the Fed's target, or proving more persistent.
But the arguments outlined at the September meeting have persisted, with some policymakers also saying they feel more and faster rate hikes are needed, potentially setting up a divided outcome and multiple dissents at the meeting later this month.

items.title: CDC sees low plague risk, monitors Siberia arrivals after worker death, director says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Director Erica Schwartz said on Wednesday the risk to the US from an unconfirmed pneumonic plague case in Siberia was extremely low, but the agency was prepared to monitor and screen travelers.
items.body:
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Director Erica Schwartz said on Wednesday the risk to the US from an unconfirmed pneumonic plague case in Siberia was extremely low, but the agency was prepared to monitor and screen travelers.
"We are working with Department of Homeland Security, working (with) Department of State, Department of War, and other agencies within the government to make sure that we know exactly if anyone from that area comes into the United States," Schwartz said at the Wall Street Journal's The Future of Health event in Washington.
The CDC has a port health station at the John F. Kennedy International Airport that can conduct surveillance and screening for travelers from the region entering the United States, she added.
The US Department of Health and Human Services did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether the agency planned to set up screening at JFK.
An HHS spokesman said there are about 200 individuals per year from the Siberian region who travel to the United States. Direct flights between Russia and the United States have been suspended since the start of the Ukraine war in 2022.
Russia's health regulator said there were [USN:SPN43X00F TEXT:"no risks"] of an epidemic breaking out in Siberia after a plague institute worker there died from pneumonia of an as-yet unestablished origin, in a case that has prompted international concern.
"What we're doing from a whole of government standpoint is we're making sure that we understand exactly what that threat is," Schwartz said.
"We are very confident that the threat to the United States is extremely low."
US President Donald Trump also [USN:S0N42W01I TEXT:"told reporters"] he does not think the death is from a bioweapon.
(This story has been corrected to change the attribution to HHS from Schwartz and to say 200 individuals per year, not 200 flights, in paragraph 5.)

FAST

Oct 7 : Florida asked a state judge on Wednesday to order changes to Instagram and Facebook to better protect young users, pressing ahead with a lawsuit accusing parent Meta Platforms of harming teens after most states resolved similar claims through a sweeping settlement.
In a filing in a Pasco County court, Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier asked for a temporary injunction forcing Meta to identify and remove users in the state under the age of 14 from those platforms, limit teens there to two hours a day across all apps and turn off features like autoplay and infinite scroll for them.
The filing asked that the changes be implemented immediately and be in place while the lawsuit moves forward.
A Meta spokesperson in a statement said after the company's settlement with nearly every other state, Florida should focus on getting other platforms to take action.

"The attorney general should be using taxpayer resources to get YouTube and TikTok to empower parents and protect teens in Florida. We regret that he has chosen instead to pursue a meritless preliminary injunction years into the litigation," the spokesperson said.
Florida's lawsuit against Meta, which accuses the company of knowingly engineering its platforms to be addictive for young users and misleading consumers about its safety, was one of dozens of similar lawsuits filed by states across the country.
In August, Meta reached settlements with 48 of the other states and Washington, DC, agreeing to pay up to $18 billion and make changes for teen users of its platforms.
Meta has said it works hard to keep teens safe on its platforms, and the company denied wrongdoing in agreeing to settle. The total payout represents about three to four months of profit and about one month of revenue for Meta. 
Uthmeier, a Republican, opted not to join the settlement and proceed with his lawsuit.
Florida said in the filing that the settlement amounted to a “mere slap on the wrist, will be cynically viewed as the cost of doing business, and in any event will not prevent this kind of behavior going forward.”
The changes Uthmeier's filing seeks are more stringent than those the company agreed to as part of that settlement, as they would cut off teens' access to messaging after their time limits are hit and bar the company from showing them advertisements.
The changes Meta agreed to make as part of the settlement are an indication these changes are possible, Uthmeier's office argued.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Tropical Storm Isaias forecast to hit US Gulf coast as hurricane early Saturday
items.author: Brad Brooks, Nathan Crooks
items.creator: Brad Brooks, Nathan Crooks
items.summary: Tropical Storm Isaias formed in the Gulf of Mexico on Wednesday and is forecast to strengthen into a hurricane before slamming into the southern US coast early on Saturday, bringing heavy rains, storm surges, and possible tornadoes across several states, the National Hurricane Center said.
items.body:
Tropical Storm Isaias formed in the Gulf of Mexico on Wednesday and is forecast to strengthen into a hurricane before slamming into the southern US coast early on Saturday, bringing heavy rains, storm surges, and possible tornadoes across several states, the National Hurricane Center said.
The storm is expected to pass through areas with significant [USN:L1N45T0JO TEXT:"offshore oil and gas production"], along with onshore refining facilities, which could pressure inventories and already-high prices at the pump.
Michael Brennan, director of the NHC, said in a video briefing on Wednesday that Isaias could be a "major" hurricane — Category 3 or higher — when it makes landfall and could have "multiple, life-threatening impacts from storm surge, heavy rainfall flooding and hurricane force winds."
Isaias would be the first hurricane of the season in the Atlantic, according to the NHC, and could tie the record for the latest first Atlantic hurricane with one that hit on October 8, 1905. The strong El Nino weather pattern this year has suppressed Atlantic hurricane development by increasing vertical wind shear, which disrupts the formation of strengthening tropical storms.
About 11.2 million barrels of oil production could be lost across the Gulf through the duration of the storm, a marked increase from the 7.1 million barrels impacted by [USN:FWN42P0ED TEXT:"Tropical Storm "]Bertha in July, according to a model forecast from consulting firm Earth Science Associates.
QUICK DEVELOPMENT, TORNADOES The NHC expects Isaias to develop into a hurricane by Thursday as it quickly picks up power over the warm Gulf waters before making landfall early on Saturday, most likely somewhere along the Mississippi, Alabama or Florida panhandle coast. The storm was located about 500 miles (805 km) south of the Louisiana coast early on Wednesday.
Isaias could produce isolated rainfall amounts of 10 inches (25.4 cm) across parts of the Gulf Coast, stretching from Louisiana to the Florida Panhandle, the NHC said in its latest bulletin.
Tornadoes are possible in the rainbands of Isaias across the Florida panhandle and Alabama from Friday evening through Saturday, with more tornadoes expected further inland as the storm moves north.
The storm could also produce 3 inches or more of rain further inland, with the NHC warning that "flash and urban flooding, along with isolated river flooding, will be possible" across the Southeast.
Isaias is expected to run into strong upper-level winds, known as vertical wind shear, in the final 24 hours before it reaches the northern Gulf Coast, which could weaken the storm.
Still, the NHC says it is “looking more likely that Isaias will be a significant hurricane when it reaches the coast.”
Florida Governor Ron DeSantis on Tuesday had already declared a state of emergency for portions of the state. Some officials across the region were urging residents to voluntarily evacuate.
Florida US Senator Rick Scott wrote on social media that he had spoken with President Donald Trump about the storm, and that "the federal government is going to show up for Florida and make sure we have everything needed to prepare, respond, and recover."
IMPACTS ON OIL, GAS The Marine Minerals Administration, which monitors offshore oil and gas operators in the Gulf of Mexico, said on Wednesday that personnel have been evacuated from eight production platforms and two non-dynamically positioned ahead of the storm.
About 25% of current oil production in the Gulf, or 511,619 barrels of oil per day, has been shut in, the agency said, citing operator reports. Just over 350 million cubic feet per day of natural gas production has also been shut in, or about 16.4% of total output from the region.
The companies with the most exposure to the storm include BP (BP.L) , Chevron (CVX.N) , ENI (ENI.MI) , Murphy Oil (MUR.N) and Shell (SHEL.L)

items.title: Liquidación de bonos Tesoro EEUU se modera, rendimientos bajan desde máximos
items.author: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
items.summary: Los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subieron el miércoles, y los rendimientos cayeron desde sus máximos a medida que bajaban los precios del petróleo y una sólida subasta de deuda a 10 años tranquilizó a los inversores al demostrar que la demanda de deuda pública a largo plazo se mantiene intacta.
items.body:
Los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subieron el miércoles, y los rendimientos cayeron desde sus máximos a medida que bajaban los precios del petróleo y una sólida subasta de deuda a 10 años tranquilizó a los inversores al demostrar que la demanda de deuda pública a largo plazo se mantiene intacta.
La deuda pública estadounidense había sufrido una renovada presión vendedora, lo que llevó a los retornos a 10 y 30 años a máximos de 24 años, al dispararse los precios del petróleo por sobre los 100 dólares. Esto reavivó los temores de que la inflación pudiera resultar más persistente de lo esperado.
Analistas dijeron que la sólida venta de 39.000 millones de dólares en deuda a 10 años desencadenó una oleada de compras en todo el mercado de bonos del Tesoro. Algunos inversores temían una demanda débil, dado el persistente sentimiento bajista hacia la deuda a más largo plazo en los últimos meses.
La caída de los precios del petróleo también contribuyó a que los rendimientos bajasen desde sus máximos, después de que la Agencia Internacional de la Energía acordase acelerar la liberación de reservas y dar prioridad al diésel, en un intento por frenar los precios récord del combustible.
En las operaciones de la tarde, el rendimiento de los bonos referenciales a 10 años subía 1,3 puntos básicos, al 5,284%, tras tocar un pico de 24 años del 5,364%, mientras que el de las notas a 30 años también alcanzaba un máximo de 24 años y luego avanzaba 2,8 pb, al 5,669%.
En el extremo más corto de la curva, el retorno de los papeles a dos años , que reflejan las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, bajaba 2,3 pb al 4,768%.
La deuda estadounidense también se vio afectada por las noticias de que SpaceX (SPCX.O) , la empresa de Elon Musk, estaba buscando una financiación de 40.000 millones de dólares para sufragar la compra de chips de Nvidia.
Si SpaceX entra en el mercado de bonos con calificación de inversión, podría reavivar las preocupaciones de que los préstamos corporativos a gran escala estén compitiendo con los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo por el capital de los inversores, según analistas.
Los responsables de la política monetaria de la Reserva Federal estuvieron divididos el mes pasado respecto de los motivos para subir las tasas de interés, mostraron las minutas de la última reunión del banco central.

items.title: 10代のチャットＧＰＴ利用、1日平均15分未満　オープンＡＩ報告書
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anzar Mehraj　Deepa Seetharaman

[７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Anzar Mehraj　Deepa Seetharaman

[７日 ロイター] - 米オープンＡＩは７日、１０代の若者による人工知能（ＡＩ）利用状況に関する初の報告書を発表した。それによると、対話型ＡＩ「チャットＧＰＴ」の１日当たりの平均利用時間は１５分未満にとどまり、３時間以上連続して利用するケースも２％未満だった。

また、長時間利用の防止に向けた「休憩リマインダー」機能が表示された対話では、ほぼ半数のユーザーが休憩を取るか、その後５分以内に利用を終了したという。

ＡＩプラットフォームが急速に普及し、若年層のメンタルヘルスや発達への影響を巡る懸念が高まる中、オープンＡＩは８月、１８歳以下向けの保護機能「チャットＧＰＴ・フォー・ティーンズ」を導入。利用者が１８歳未満と推定された場合や、１３─１７歳と自己申告した場合に適用され、自傷行為や暴力、摂食障害など高リスク分野の対話を制限するほか、保護者による管理機能を強化した。

一方、非営利団体「コモン・センス・メディア」は同日公表した報告書で、テスト用アカウントでは保護機能があっても、自殺や自傷行為、摂食障害に関する会話が行われた際、保護者への通知が遅れるか、全く送信されないケースが多かったと指摘した。

これに対しオープンＡＩの広報担当者は、同調査は若年層向け安全対策を「正確に反映していない」と反論。セキュリティーや規模を理由に、保護者アカウントと若者アカウントの連携や安全アラートの有効化に数時間かかる場合があると説明した。

items.title: Meta says strengthened systems, deployed new LLMs to prevent, detect CSAM
items.author: Aashish Aryan
items.summary: Meta says a dedicated language model, AI sweeps and a red-teaming agent will help detect harmful ads, identify gaps in its defences and stop banned users returning ...
items.body: Social media giant Meta on Wednesday said it has improved its child sexual abuse material (CSAM) detection systems to improve the “efficacy” of its systems in preventing such content from being posted across its platforms. The company listed a series of improvements, such as deploying a new large language model (LLM) to flag advertising content that may look relatively harmless but shows indicators of redirecting users to illegal and harmful content off Meta’s platforms. In a blog post, Meta said that while it continued to detect, investigate and remove CSAM from its platforms, bad actors had resorted to newer methods, such as using advertisements to redirect people to other third-party platforms. “Once we understood the design of this malicious advertising scheme, we didn’t stop at the ones reported to us. We widened our investigation to find related activity across our platforms, disabled the violating accounts behind it, and blocked the off-platform links involved,” the company said in a blog post. In addition to deploying the dedicated LLM, Meta has also launched new artificial intelligence (AI)-driven “sweeps of ad content” to look for child sexual abuse and exploitative material that its systems did not catch, the company said in the blog post. A red-teaming AI agent has also been deployed by the company to find loopholes in Meta’s defences against CSAM, so that these weaknesses can be found and corrected, the company said. Meta has also strengthened its systems for identifying bad actors who try to return to its platforms after their accounts are removed, the blog post said. These actions by the social media conglomerate come within a month of the company’s top executives being summoned by the Indian government over alleged failures to contain CSAM and allowing advertisements that promoted such material across its platforms. Last month, Meta became the first social media platform to agree to share details of CSAM cases and repeat offenders with Indian law enforcement agencies. Until then, all US-headquartered social media platforms, including Meta, shared instances of CSAM only with the National Centre for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC), a private US non-profit organisation. The NCMEC would then share the details of repeat offenders or other such online accounts with the law enforcement agencies in their respective domains. Google soon followed suit and said that it would also start sharing these details with Indian law enforcement agencies.

PARIS, Oct 7 : Biman Bangladesh Airlines has ordered 10 Airbus jets, the European planemaker said on Wednesday.
The order, which had been expected after Biman recently ordered 11 Boeing aircraft, includes four long-haul A350-900 and six medium-haul A231neo jets.
Biman last month ordered 11 Boeing 787 Dreamliner jets and 737 MAX aircraft.
The airline, whose fleet of 19 aircraft consists mainly of Boeing jets and Dash-8 turboprops, serves slightly more than 20 per cent of the country's air passengers, Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister M. Rashiduzzaman Millat said late last month.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-サウジ、フライドバイ機刺傷事件で安全調査開始　刑事捜査とは別
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Allison Lampert　Tim Hepher　Steven Scheer　Federico Maccioni

[７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Allison Lampert　Tim Hepher　Steven Scheer　Federico Maccioni

[７日 ロイター] - ９月３０日に発生したフライドバイＦＺ１０７３便の操縦室内刺傷事件を受け、サウジアラビアが航空事故調査に着手したことが分かった。関係者３人が明らかにした。アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）主導の刑事捜査とは別に、事件が航空安全にもたらす影響を専門家が精査する。

事故後に航空の安全確保を目的とした安全調査を実施するのは通例だが、フライドバイ機の事案のように、故意の行為が関与する場合には義務ではない。

これまで、サウジがこのような調査を実施するかどうかは不明だった。専門家によると、今回の調査は、責任追及ではなく安全確保のための勧告を目的とする国際協力体制が試される可能性がある。

関係者によると、サウジは海外の航空安全当局に対し、国際ルールに基づきＦＺ１０７３便の安全調査を実施すると通知した。この便は、副操縦士が機長をおので襲撃した際、サウジ領空内を飛行していた。

事故調査を担当するサウジの国家交通安全センター、サウジ政府および同国の規制当局のコメントは得られていない。

ＵＡＥは既に、この事件について別途刑事捜査を開始している。

搭乗していた１７２人のほぼ全員を自国民が占めたイスラエルは、サウジ主導の安全調査への参加を申し出たが、同国航空事故当局によると、現時点では招待を受けていない。

サウジとイスラエルは国交がない。ただ、専門家によると、事故率の大幅な低下に大きく貢献したとされる数十年来の事故防止協力体制は、政治的な一線を越えることが可能だという。

Local media reported that 107 people were arrested in Belgium in recent days.

High school students hold placards and shout slogans as they take part in a spontaneous street protest against education reforms introduced by the Wallonia-Brussels Federation government and an increase in student fees, in Liege, Belgium, Oct 7, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Stephanie Lecocq)

LIEGE: Hundreds of students , inspired in part by education al unrest in neighbouring France , have taken to the streets of the Belgian city of Liège, with local media reporting 107 arrests in recent days.
Local authorities could not immediately be reached to confirm the arrests, which the Belga news agency reported were linked to offences including property damage and arson.
Students have protested over Belgium's French-language education system, citing rising education costs , over crowded classrooms and difficulties accessing study materials.
They held signs with slogans including "It's a mess, we are fighting for a right! Not a privilege!" and "I chose education , not the hunger games!!".
